lec03-bp-v2-root.name: 反向傳播與最佳化知識地圖

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u01.name: 優化搜尋參數，反傳計算梯度

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u02.name: 梯度下降沿反方向更新參數

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u03.name: 停表準則是儀表而非最優證明

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u04.name: 線搜索試步長，不降就減半

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u05.name: 動量把歷史位移加進本步更新

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u06.name: 反向傳播先算全部梯度，再更新參數

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u07.name: 單樣本梯度以便宜換取抽樣雜訊

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u08.name: 小批次先平均，每次更新後重算梯度

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u09.name: 收斂率必須連同假設與量測量解讀

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u10.name: AdaGrad 用逐座標平方歷史調整步幅

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u11.name: RMSProp 與 Adam 管理近期梯度資訊

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u12.name: 平坦極小值是局部穩健性的條件線索

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u15.name: 收斂保證需要明確假設

lec03-bp-v2-scene-u16.name: 訓練成功仍須驗證泛化

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n01.text: 訓練搜尋參數，反傳只算梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n04.text:
① 假設類別：選模型家族。
*1. A hypothesis class specifies the model family.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n05.text:
② 損失函數：讓模型表現可比較。
*2. A loss function makes model performance comparable.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p01-n06.text:
③ 優化：調參數使損失降低。
反傳以鏈式法則算梯度：各參數的偏導數向量。
*3. Optimization changes parameters to reduce loss.*
*Backpropagation uses the chain rule to compute the vector of partial derivatives.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n01.text: 百萬參數的完整海森矩陣需八兆位元組

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n02.text: *A dense Hessian needs eight terabytes for a million parameters*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n05.text:
每個數字存 8 bytes；n 是參數個數。
Hessian 是二階偏導數組成的 n×n 矩陣。
*Each number occupies 8 bytes; n is the number of parameters.*
*The Hessian is the n-by-n matrix of second partial derivatives.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p02-n06.text:
梯度：8 MB；完整 Hessian：8 TB。
單位採十進位，不含其他訓練記憶體。
*The gradient uses 8 MB; the full Hessian uses 8 TB.*
*Units are decimal and exclude other training memory.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n01.text: 練習：本章聚焦哪個機器學習步驟？

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n02.text: *Which machine-learning step does this chapter focus on?*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n04.text:
機器學習三個步驟中，本章聚焦的是哪一步？
A. 提出假設類別
B. 定義損失函數
C. 搜尋最佳假設（優化）
D. 資料前處理
*Which machine-learning step does this chapter focus on?*
*A. Propose a hypothesis class.*
*B. Define a loss function.*
*C. Search for the best hypothesis through optimization.*
*D. Preprocess data.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p03-n05.text:
提示：先區分「選模型、定評分、調參數」三件事。
*Hint: Distinguish choosing a model, defining scores, and adjusting parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n01.text: 完整矩陣的儲存量隨參數平方增長

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n02.text: *Dense-matrix storage grows quadratically with parameter count*

image.alt:
讀圖：橫軸是參數 n，縱軸是 bytes。
藍線為 8n，橘線為 8n²。 (Read parameter count n horizontally and bytes vertically.
The blue curve is 8n; the orange curve is 8n squared.)

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n05.text:
讀圖：橫軸是參數 n，縱軸是 bytes。
藍線為 8n，橘線為 8n²。
*Read parameter count n horizontally and bytes vertically.*
*The blue curve is 8n; the orange curve is 8n squared.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p04-n06.text:
兩軸為對數刻度；只比較儲存量。
*Both axes use logarithmic scales; only storage is compared.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n01.text: 小模型也能看見平方成本

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n02.text: *Even small models reveal the quadratic cost*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n04.text:
n=100：梯度 100 個；Hessian 10,000 個。
*At n=100, the gradient has 100 entries and the Hessian has 10,000.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p05-n05.text:
n=10,000：梯度 10,000 個；Hessian 10⁸ 個。
*At n=10,000, the gradient has 10,000 entries and the Hessian has 100 million.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n01.text: 一階看梯度，二階也看曲率

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n02.text: *First-order methods use gradients; second-order methods also use curvature*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n04.text:
一階：梯度是損失對各參數的偏導數。
隨機版本是大型網路訓練主力。
*First-order methods use partial derivatives of loss.*
*Stochastic variants are central to large-network training.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p06-n05.text:
二階：Hessian 記錄偏導數的再變化。
Newton 法解線性系統，未必顯式求逆；條件合適時局部收斂較快。
*Second-order methods use the Hessian of second derivatives.*
*Newton methods solve a linear system, need not form an inverse, and can converge faster locally under suitable conditions.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n01.text: 平坦與泛化的關係需要條件

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n02.text: *The connection between flatness and generalization needs qualifications*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n04.text:
來源觀察：隨機一階方法常找到較平坦的解。
*The source reports that stochastic first-order methods often find flatter solutions.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p07-n05.text:
更正：平坦不自動等於泛化好；二階也不必然較差。
*Correction: flatness does not automatically imply better generalization, and second-order methods are not necessarily worse.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n01.text: 摸坡靠反傳，移動靠優化器

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n02.text: *Backpropagation measures the slope; the optimizer makes the move*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p08-n04.text:
人生下山找谷底：
摸坡靠反傳，走路靠一階。
*Training is like descending toward a valley:*
*backpropagation measures slopes; first-order methods guide movement.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n01.text: 先掌握更新與反傳兩個地基

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n04.text:
§2 梯度下降：怎麼更新參數。
*Section 2 explains how gradient descent updates parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n05.text:
§3 反向傳播：怎麼高效算梯度。
*Section 3 explains how backpropagation computes gradients efficiently.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p09-n06.text:
§4 隨機與 mini-batch：用資料子集近似梯度。
*Section 4 uses stochastic and mini-batch estimates of gradients.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p10-n01.text: 把名詞還原成各自的工作

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p10-n04.text:
假設類別選家族；損失函數定代價；
優化找參數；鏈式法則串偏導。
*A hypothesis class selects a family; a loss assigns costs.*
*Optimization finds parameters; the chain rule links derivatives.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n01.text: 進階方法調步長並研究解的性質

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n02.text: *Advanced methods adjust steps and study properties of solutions*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n04.text:
§5 AdaGrad、RMSProp、Adam：自適應學習率。
*Section 5 covers adaptive learning rates with AdaGrad, RMSProp, and Adam.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n05.text:
§6 SAM：Sharpness-Aware Minimization。
考量參數擾動附近的損失。
*Section 6 covers Sharpness-Aware Minimization.*
*It considers loss near parameter perturbations.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p11-n06.text:
§7 收斂理論：過參數化網路的優化行為。
*Section 7 studies convergence in overparameterized networks.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n01.text: 原題：反向傳播解決的核心難題是？

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n04.text:
反向傳播解決的核心難題是？
A. 如何設計激活函數
B. 如何高效計算多層網路各參數對最終損失的梯度
C. 如何收集訓練資料
D. 如何選擇 batch size
*What central difficulty does backpropagation solve?*
*A. Designing activation functions.*
*B. Efficiently computing each multilayer-network parameter’s gradient of the final loss.*
*C. Collecting training data.*
*D. Choosing the batch size.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p12-n05.text:
提示：分清「提供敏感度」與「使用敏感度更新」。
*Hint: Separate supplying sensitivities from using them to update parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n01.text: 晚餐比喻只描述搜尋資訊的成本

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n02.text: *The dinner analogy describes the cost of search information*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n04.text:
陌生城市找便宜晚餐：
先問附近方向，不先列全城曲率表。
*To find a cheap dinner in an unfamiliar city,*
*ask for local directions rather than tabulate curvature everywhere.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p13-n05.text:
侷限：局部詢問不能證明找到全城最便宜。
*Limit: local inquiries cannot certify the cheapest dinner in the entire city.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n01.text: 原題：偏好一階方法的主要原因不包括？

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n02.text: *Which item is not a main reason for preferring first-order methods?*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n04.text:
深度學習實務上偏好一階方法而非二階方法，主要原因不包括？
A. 二階方法需計算與反轉 Hessian，算力負擔大
B. 一階隨機方法常找到較平坦最小值、泛化較好
C. 二階方法在深度學習規模下計算不可行
D. 二階方法永遠找不到任何局部最低點
*Which item is not a main reason for preferring first-order methods?*
*A. Computing and inverting a Hessian imposes a large cost.*
*B. Stochastic first-order methods often find flatter minima with better generalization.*
*C. Second-order computation is infeasible at deep-learning scale.*
*D. Second-order methods can never find a local minimum.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p14-n05.text:
提示：原題措辭偏強；請依前頁更正，區分成本與不可能。
*Hint: The source wording is strong; distinguish high cost from impossibility using the corrections.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n01.text: 資源取捨不是方法的絕對排名

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n02.text: *Resource trade-offs do not give an absolute ranking of methods*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n04.text:
二階方法不是永遠更好，也不是永遠無用。
*Second-order methods are neither always superior nor always useless.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p15-n05.text:
大型訓練常選一階；理由是成本與實務取捨。
*Large-scale training often uses first-order methods because of computational and practical trade-offs.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n01.text: 原題：核心必讀與進階補充如何對應？

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n02.text: *How do the core material and advanced supplements correspond?*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n04.text:
本章核心必讀內容與進階補充的正確對應是？
A. §2 梯度下降 + §3 backprop 為核心；§4–§7 為進階與理論
B. 只有 §6 SAM 是核心
C. §7 理論是唯一必讀
D. §4 SGD 取代 §3 backprop 成為核心
*How do the core material and advanced supplements correspond?*
*A. Sections 2 and 3 are core; Sections 4–7 provide advanced methods and theory.*
*B. Only Section 6 on SAM is core.*
*C. Section 7 on theory is the only required reading.*
*D. Section 4 on SGD replaces Section 3 as the core.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p16-n05.text:
提示：回看兩張路線圖，找出後續方法依賴的地基。
*Hint: Use the roadmap to identify the foundations required by later methods.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n01.text: 讀符號也要看它在做什麼

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n02.text: *Read each symbol together with its task*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p17-n04.text:
向量列偏導，矩陣列曲率；
先數元素，再算資源成本。
*Vectors collect derivatives and matrices collect curvature.*
*Count their entries before estimating resource costs.*

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p18-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p18-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p18-n01.text: 符號先對照意義再代入

lec03-bp-v2-u01-p18-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u01-p18-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u01-p18-n02.text: *Match symbols to their meanings before substitution*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u01.name: KP01：優化搜尋參數，反傳計算梯度
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u01.text: 優化搜尋參數，反傳計算梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n01.text: 負梯度決定方向，學習率決定步長

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n02.text: *The negative gradient sets direction; the learning rate sets scale*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p01-n05.text:
w 是參數向量，k 是迭代，f 是損失。
梯度由偏導數組成；η>0 是學習率。
負梯度在歐氏距離下是最陡局部下降方向。
*w is the parameter vector, k the iteration, and f the loss.*
*The gradient collects partial derivatives; positive eta is the learning rate.*
*The negative gradient is the steepest local descent direction under Euclidean distance.*

先算目前梯度，再減去縮放後的梯度。
*Compute the current gradient, then subtract its scaled value.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n01.text: 二次谷底第一步從四降到三點二

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n02.text: *The first quadratic step moves from four to 3.2*

image.alt:
f(w)=w²，起點 4，η=0.1。
梯度 f′(4)=2×4=8。 (For f(w)=w squared, start at 4 with eta=0.1.
The derivative at 4 is 2 times 4, equal to 8.)

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n05.text:
讀圖：橫軸 w，縱軸 loss。
*The x-axis shows w; the y-axis shows loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n06.text:
f(w)=w²，起點 4，η=0.1。
梯度 f′(4)=2×4=8。
*For f(w)=w squared, start at 4 with eta=0.1.*
*The derivative at 4 is 2 times 4, equal to 8.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p02-n07.text:
位移 −0.1×8=−0.8；
新損失 3.2²=10.24，低於 4²=16。
*The displacement is minus 0.1 times 8, equal to minus 0.8.*
*The new loss is 3.2 squared, or 10.24, below 16.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n01.text: 練習：更新式中的學習率代表什麼？

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n02.text: *What does eta represent in the update rule?*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n04.text:
式 (4) 梯度下降更新 $\mathbf{w}^{(k+1)}:=\mathbf{w}^{(k)}-\eta\nabla f(\mathbf{w}^{(k)})$ 中，$\eta$ 代表什麼？
A. Lipschitz 常數
B. 學習率（固定步長）
C. 動量係數
D. batch size
*What does eta represent in the update rule?*
*A. A Lipschitz constant.*
*B. The learning rate, used as a fixed step scale.*
*C. A momentum coefficient.*
*D. The batch size.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p03-n05.text:
提示：把更新拆成「梯度方向」與「乘上的正數」。
*Hint: Separate the gradient direction from the positive scaling factor.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n01.text: 最小化任務透過逐步位移實現

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n02.text: *A minimization task is implemented through repeated displacements*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n04.text:
先選初始位置 w⁽⁰⁾，通常用隨機初始化。
*Choose an initial position, often through random initialization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p04-n09.text:
更新量 Δw 是本次位移；w* 表示目標最優解。
*Delta w is the current displacement; w star denotes an optimal solution.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n01.text: 光滑性限制相鄰位置的梯度變化

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n02.text: *Smoothness bounds changes in gradients between nearby positions*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n04.text:
L>0 是梯度的 Lipschitz 常數。
光滑指梯度變化有上界，不是函數值有上界。
*Positive L is a Lipschitz constant for the gradient.*
*Smoothness bounds gradient changes, not the function values.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n05.text:
對 f(w)=w²，|2u−2v|=2|u−v|，可取 L=2。
*For f(w)=w squared, the gradient difference is twice the position difference, so L=2 works.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p05-n06.text:
$$
\|\nabla f(\mathbf u)-\nabla f(\mathbf v)\|_2\le L\|\mathbf u-\mathbf v\|_2
$$

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n01.text: 矇眼下山仍要限制每步距離

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n02.text: *Descending blindfolded still requires a safe step length*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p06-n04.text:
摸當前坡度，走最陡反方向；
太大會拍皮球，太小會走得慢。
*Measure the current slope and move against it.*
*Oversized steps can bounce; undersized steps can progress slowly.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n01.text: 倒數光滑常數是一個安全步長

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n02.text: *The reciprocal smoothness constant is a safe step size*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n04

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p07-n05.text:
更正：「理想」不是所有問題的最優步長。
光滑且梯度非零時，取 1/L 可嚴格下降。
*Correction: this is not the best step for every problem.*
*With smoothness and a nonzero gradient, choosing 1/L gives strict descent.*

二次例 L=2，故 1/L=0.5。L 未知時需選或調 η。
*In the quadratic example L=2, so 1/L=0.5.*
*If L is unknown, eta must be selected or adjusted.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n01.text: 第二步必須重算當前坡度

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n02.text: *The second step requires a fresh gradient*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n04.text:
沿用 f(w)=w²、η=0.1，現在 w=3.2。
梯度 2×3.2=6.4；縮放量 0.1×6.4=0.64。
*Keep the quadratic loss and eta=0.1, now at w=3.2.*
*The gradient is 6.4; its scaled amount is 0.64.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p08-n07.text:
因梯度變小，這次位移也變小。
$f(2.56)=2.56^2=2.56\times2.56=6.5536$。
*The smaller gradient produces a smaller displacement.*
*Substitute the new position into the squared loss and multiply to obtain 6.5536.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n01.text: 第三步延續相同更新規則

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n02.text: *The third step follows the same update rule*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n04.text:
目前 w=2.56，梯度 2×2.56=5.12。
0.1×5.12=0.512 是本次縮放量。
*At w=2.56, the gradient is 5.12.*
*The scaled amount is 0.1 times 5.12, equal to 0.512.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p09-n05.text:
目前損失 6.5536；更新後 2.048²=4.194304。
最後一項是為完整檢查補算的值。
*The current loss is 6.5536; the updated loss is 4.194304.*
*The final value is added to complete the check.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n01.text: 學習率為一時會在兩壁往返

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n02.text: *A learning rate of one bounces between two walls*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n06.text:
從 4 出發，η=1；兩次梯度分別為 8、−8。
*Starting at 4 with eta=1, the successive gradients are 8 and minus 8.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p10-n07.text:
兩端損失都是 16，並未下降。
二次函數更新為 w新=(1−2η)w。
*Both endpoints have loss 16, so no descent occurs.*
*For this quadratic, the new position is (1 minus 2 eta) times w.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n01.text: 凸與非凸的保證都依賴前提

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n02.text: *Guarantees for convex and nonconvex objectives depend on assumptions*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n04.text:
凸：線段上的函數值不高於端點加權平均。
凸且 L-smooth、有最小值，步長適當：可保證目標值趨向全域最小值。
*Convexity bounds values on a line segment by weighted endpoint values.*
*With L-smoothness, a minimizer, and suitable steps, objective values approach the global minimum.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p11-n05.text:
更正：非凸不能只保證局部最低；也可能到鞍點。
下降保證須看光滑性與步長。
*Correction: nonconvex optimization may reach a saddle, not necessarily a local minimum.*
*Descent requires smoothness and step-size conditions.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p13-n02.text: *The air-conditioning analogy maps direction and response speed*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p13-n04.text:
室溫 28°C，目標 24°C：依偏熱或偏冷反向調整。

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n01.text: 換個谷底仍使用同一更新式

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n02.text: *A shifted valley uses the same update structure*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n04.text:
練習：f(w)=(w−1)²、w⁽⁰⁾=5、η=0.25，走兩步。
*Practice: use f(w)=(w minus 1) squared, start at 5, and take two steps with eta=0.25.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p14-n05.text:
提示：先微分，再代入目前 w；每步都重算梯度。
不要把 w 當成距離谷底的誤差。
*Hint: differentiate, substitute the current w, and recompute the gradient after each step.*
*Do not confuse w with its distance from the minimum.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n01.text: 向下走一步，不等於已知終點

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n02.text: *A downward step does not identify the destination*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p15-n04.text:
矇眼下山，走最陡反方向；
步長要合適，終點要另檢查。
*Descend against the steepest local slope.*
*Choose suitable steps and assess the destination separately.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n01.text: 原題：光滑設定下原文選哪個步長？

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n02.text: *Which step size does the source choose under smoothness?*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n04.text:
若 $f(\cdot)$ 的梯度是 $L$-smooth，理想步長應取？
A. $\eta=L$
B. $\eta=1/L$
C. $\eta=L^2$
D. $\eta=0$
*Which step size does the source choose under smoothness?*
*A. Eta equals L.*
*B. Eta equals the reciprocal of L.*
*C. Eta equals L squared.*
*D. Eta equals zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p16-n05.text:

*Hint: Interpret the source’s “ideal” step as a safe choice, not a universal optimum.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n01.text: 最大化時沿正梯度移動

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n02.text: *Maximization moves in the positive gradient direction*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p17-n05.text:
梯度上升用於最大化；符號改成加號。
方向仍是局部判斷，步長不能任意放大。
*Gradient ascent maximizes an objective and uses a plus sign.*
*The direction is local; the step cannot be enlarged arbitrarily.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n01.text: 原題：原文對凸目標提出什麼保證？

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n02.text: *What guarantee does the source state for a convex objective?*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n04.text:
對凸目標函數 $f(\cdot)$，梯度下降的保證是？
A. 收斂到局部最低點且 loss 可能上升
B. 收斂到全域最低點且 loss 單調遞減
C. 一定發散
D. 與初始點無關永遠找到同一鞍點
*What guarantee does the source state for a convex objective?*
*A. Convergence to a local minimum while loss may rise.*
*B. Convergence to a global minimum with monotonically decreasing loss.*
*C. Certain divergence.*
*D. Always reaching the same saddle regardless of initialization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p18-n05.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n01.text: 原題：原文描述非凸地形的實務表現為何？

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n02.text: *How does the source describe practical behavior on nonconvex landscapes?*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n04.text:
非凸 loss 地形上，梯度下降的實務表現如何？
A. 完全無法使用
B. 只能找到全域最優
C. 可能震盪但整體 loss 傾向下降
D. 保證每步 loss 嚴格遞減
*How does the source describe practical behavior on nonconvex landscapes?*
*A. It is entirely unusable.*
*B. It can only find the global optimum.*
*C. It may oscillate while loss tends to decline overall.*
*D. Every step is guaranteed to decrease loss strictly.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p20-n05.text:
提示：區分來源的經驗描述與需要條件的數學保證。
*Hint: Distinguish an empirical description from a mathematical guarantee that needs assumptions.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n01.text: 符號先對照意義再代入

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n02.text: *Match symbols to their meanings before substitution*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p21-n05.text:
$f$：可微目標／損失
*differentiable objective or loss*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n01.text: 先認量，再選公式與判準

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n02.text: *Identify the quantity before choosing a formula or criterion*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p22-n04.text:
參數、梯度、損失、步長各司其職；
符號相近，也不代表量相同。
*Parameters, gradients, losses, and steps have different roles.*
*Similar symbols need not represent the same quantity.*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n01.text: 符號先對照意義再代入（續）

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n02.text: *Match symbols to their meanings before substitution (continued)*

lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u02-p23-n04.text:
$L$：梯度變化上界常數
*gradient Lipschitz constant*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u02.name: KP02：梯度下降沿反方向更新參數
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u02.text: 梯度下降沿反方向更新參數

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n01.text: 停表看儀表，不等於證明到谷底

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n02.text: *Stopping checks indicators; it does not certify a minimum*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n04.text:
火車進站看四塊表：
坡度、loss 差、梯度差、計算次數。
*Stopping resembles a train using four indicators:*
*slope, loss change, gradient change, and iteration count.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p01-n05.text:
門檻 ε>0 是容忍值；各儀表量測的量不同。
*A positive epsilon is a tolerance; each indicator measures a different quantity.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n01.text: 第三步兩種停表儀表會分歧

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n02.text: *At the third step, two stopping indicators disagree*

image.alt:
f(w)=w²、η=0.25、w⁽⁰⁾=1、ε=0.05。
更新是 w−0.25(2w)=0.5w；每次乘 0.5，
1→0.5→0.25→0.125。 (Use the quadratic loss, eta=0.25, start at 1, and epsilon=0.05.
The update equals 0.5w: multiply by 0.5 each time to obtain 0.5, 0.25, then 0.125.)

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n05.text:
讀圖：橫軸迭代 k，縱軸儀表值。
*The x-axis shows k; the y-axis shows each indicator.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n06.text:
f(w)=w²、η=0.25、w⁽⁰⁾=1、ε=0.05。
更新是 w−0.25(2w)=0.5w；每次乘 0.5，
1→0.5→0.25→0.125。
*Use the quadratic loss, eta=0.25, start at 1, and epsilon=0.05.*
*The update equals 0.5w: multiply by 0.5 each time to obtain 0.5, 0.25, then 0.125.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p02-n07.text:
loss 差 0.046875≤0.05；
0.125²=0.015625，0.25²=0.0625。
梯度 |2×0.125|=0.25>0.05。
*The losses are 0.015625 and 0.0625, giving a change below 0.05.*
*The gradient magnitude is 2 times 0.125, or 0.25, exceeding 0.05.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n01.text: 練習：一階最優性條件提供哪種停表動機？

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n02.text: *Which stopping criterion is motivated by first-order optimality?*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n04.text:
一階最優性條件 $\|\nabla f(\mathbf{w}^{*})\|_2=0$ 對應哪種收斂準則的動機？
A. 最大迭代次數
B. 梯度範數夠小
C. batch size 夠大
D. 學習率歸零
*Which stopping criterion is motivated by first-order optimality?*
*A. A maximum iteration count.*
*B. A small gradient norm.*
*C. A sufficiently large batch size.*
*D. A learning rate of zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p03-n05.text:
提示：一階最優性是無約束可微問題的必要條件；辨識它量測什麼。
*Hint: First-order optimality is necessary for an unconstrained differentiable optimum; identify the quantity measured.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n01.text: 小梯度只代表一階近似平坦

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n02.text: *A small gradient indicates approximate first-order stationarity*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p04-n06.text:
無約束可微函數在局部最小點 w*，梯度必為零。
*For an unconstrained differentiable function, the gradient is zero at a local minimum.*

停止時容許梯度範數不超過 ε；這是近似駐點測試。
*A stopping rule allows the gradient norm to be at most epsilon; it tests approximate stationarity.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n01.text: 小損失差不保證梯度也小

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n02.text: *Small loss changes do not guarantee small gradients*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n04.text:
loss 差衡量連續兩步的改善幅度。
太小的步長也能讓改善變小。
*Loss change measures improvement between consecutive steps.*
*A very small step can also make improvement small.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p05-n05.text:
可看連續 N 步，而非只看單步；但仍不是最優證書。
*Check N consecutive steps rather than only one; this still does not certify optimality.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n01.text: 鞍點沿兩個方向有相反曲率

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n02.text: *A saddle curves in opposite ways along two directions*

image.alt:
[補充] 用 f(x,y)=x²−y² 精確說明鞍點。
原點梯度 (0,0)，卻沿 y 方向降低。 ([Added] The function x squared minus y squared gives an exact saddle example.
Its gradient vanishes at the origin, yet loss decreases along y.)

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n05.text:
[補充] 用 f(x,y)=x²−y² 精確說明鞍點。
原點梯度 (0,0)，卻沿 y 方向降低。
*[Added] The function x squared minus y squared gives an exact saddle example.*
*Its gradient vanishes at the origin, yet loss decreases along y.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p06-n06.text:
讀圖：兩條截面經同一原點，一條向上、一條向下。
*Read two sections through the same origin: one rises and the other falls.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n01.text: 梯度變化小並非梯度本身小

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n02.text: *A stable gradient is not necessarily a small gradient*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n04.text:
更正：梯度是向量，前後差應用範數。
單純絕對值記號只適合一維。
*Correction: use a norm for differences between gradient vectors.*
*Absolute-value notation is appropriate only in one dimension.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p07-n05.text:
穩定可以仍很陡；此判據較少單獨使用。
*A stable gradient may still be large; this criterion is rarely used alone.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n01.text: 第一步先建立可比較的儀表值

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n02.text: *The first step establishes comparable indicator values*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n04.text:
η=0.25；更新為 w新=w−0.25(2w)=0.5w。
*With eta=0.25, the update is w minus 0.25 times 2w, equal to 0.5w.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p08-n07.text:
w⁽¹⁾=0.5；f=0.5²=0.25；|f′|=|2×0.5|=1。
loss 差 |0.25−1|=0.75。
*The first position is 0.5, with loss 0.25 and gradient magnitude 1.*
*The loss change is the absolute difference between 0.25 and 1, equal to 0.75.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n01.text: 第二步繼續重算位置與坡度

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n02.text: *The second step recomputes position and slope*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n04.text:
w⁽²⁾=0.5−0.25(1)=0.25；
f=0.25²=0.0625，|f′|=0.5。
*The second position is 0.5 minus 0.25 times 1, equal to 0.25.*
*Its loss is 0.0625 and gradient magnitude is 0.5.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p09-n05.text:
loss 差 |0.0625−0.25|=0.1875；仍超過 0.05。
*The loss change is 0.1875, still greater than 0.05.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n01.text: 第三步的位置與梯度各有依據

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n02.text: *The third-step position and gradient have explicit derivations*

image.alt:
w⁽³⁾=0.25−0.25(0.5)=0.125；
f=0.125²=0.015625。 (The third position is 0.25 minus 0.25 times 0.5, equal to 0.125.
Its loss is 0.015625.)

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n05.text:
讀圖：橫軸迭代 k，縱軸儀表值。
*The x-axis shows k; the y-axis shows each indicator.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n06.text:
w⁽³⁾=0.25−0.25(0.5)=0.125；
f=0.125²=0.015625。
*The third position is 0.25 minus 0.25 times 0.5, equal to 0.125.*
*Its loss is 0.015625.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p10-n07.text:
|f′|=|2×0.125|=0.25。
loss 差過門檻，不代表梯度也過門檻。
*The gradient magnitude is 2 times 0.125, equal to 0.25.*
*Passing the loss-change threshold does not imply passing the gradient threshold.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p11-n01.text: 煎牛排的不同儀表回答不同問題

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p11-n04.text:
煎牛排可看溫度、上色變化、火候或計時器。
比喻用來辨認不同判準，不是證明收斂。
*Cooking can use temperature, color change, heat control, or a timer.*
*The analogy distinguishes criteria; it does not prove convergence.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n01.text: 原題：非凸時只看小梯度可能出什麼問題？

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n02.text: *What can happen when only a small-gradient test is used in a nonconvex problem?*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n04.text:
在非凸設定下，僅用「梯度範數 $\leq \epsilon$」停表，可能發生什麼問題？
A. 一定找到全域最優
B. 可能收斂到鞍點
C. 梯度永遠不會變小
D. loss 一定發散
*What can happen when only a small-gradient test is used in a nonconvex problem?*
*A. The global optimum is guaranteed.*
*B. The method may converge to a saddle.*
*C. The gradient can never become small.*
*D. Loss must diverge.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p12-n05.text:
提示：思考「必要條件」能否反向推出「充分條件」。
*Hint: Ask whether a necessary condition can be reversed into a sufficient condition.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n01.text: 到最大次數只是預算已用完

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n02.text: *Reaching the iteration limit means the budget is exhausted*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n04.text:
step 是一次參數更新；epoch 是完整走過訓練資料一輪。
*A step is one parameter update; an epoch is one full pass through the training data.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p13-n05.text:
可設 loss 連續 N 步變化小，或達到 100 epoch 就停。
停止不表示已數學收斂。
*Stop after small loss changes for N steps or after 100 epochs.*
*Stopping does not imply mathematical convergence.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n01.text: 宣佈到站看儀表，山口不一定是谷底

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n02.text: *Read the indicators; a mountain pass is not necessarily a minimum*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p14-n04.text:
坡夠平、高度差小、方向穩、或時間到；
儀表會吵架，所以要交代停止邏輯。
*Stop for small slopes, small loss changes, stable gradients, or exhausted time.*
*Indicators may disagree, so state the stopping logic.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n01.text: 原題：連續兩步損失差小代表什麼？

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n02.text: *What does a small absolute loss difference between two steps represent?*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n04.text:
$|f(\mathbf{w}^{(k+1)})-f(\mathbf{w}^{(k)})|\leq\epsilon$ 這條準則代表？
A. 連續兩步 loss 變化夠小
B. 梯度為零
C. 達到最大 epoch
D. Hessian 為零
*What does a small absolute loss difference between two steps represent?*
*A. A sufficiently small loss change between consecutive steps.*
*B. A zero gradient.*
*C. Reaching the maximum epoch count.*
*D. A zero Hessian.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p15-n05.text:
提示：直接辨認式子的量，不把它換成另一種儀表。
*Hint: Identify the measured quantity directly rather than substituting another indicator.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n01.text: 改門檻不等於改更新軌跡

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n02.text: *Changing a threshold does not change the update trajectory*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p16-n04.text:
固定更新法，再換停止門檻；
問的是何時亮燈，不是如何走路。
*Fix the update rule, then change the stopping tolerance.*
*Ask when the indicator triggers, not how the parameters move.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n01.text: 調整門檻後要重新逐列判斷

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n02.text: *Changing the tolerance requires checking every row again*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n04.text:
練習：把二次例的 ε 改成 0.3。
梯度範數會在哪一步首次不超過門檻？
*Practice: change epsilon to 0.3 in the quadratic example.*
*At which step does the gradient norm first satisfy the threshold?*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p17-n05.text:
提示：固定原更新序列，只改判斷值；不改 η。
*Hint: keep the update sequence and eta fixed; change only the comparison threshold.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n01.text: 有限訓練也要記錄停止理由

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n02.text: *Finite training still needs a recorded stopping reason*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p18-n04.text:
到點收工是預算選擇；
把停止原因與收斂結論分開。
*Stopping on schedule is a budget choice.*
*Separate the stopping reason from a convergence claim.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n01.text: 原題：來源列的常見訓練停表方式為何？

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n02.text: *Which stopping method does the source describe as common in training?*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n04.text:
深度學習訓練中最常見的停表方式是？
A. 嚴格等到梯度範數精確為 0
B. 預先設定的最大迭代次數（epoch / step）
C. 必須解出 Hessian 特徵值
D. 永遠不停止
*Which stopping method does the source describe as common in training?*
*A. Wait until the gradient norm is exactly zero.*
*B. Use a preset maximum iteration count in epochs or steps.*
*C. Always compute Hessian eigenvalues.*
*D. Never stop.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p19-n05.text:
提示：分清數學收斂要求與有限計算預算。
*Hint: Separate mathematical convergence from a finite computation budget.*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n01.text: 符號先對照意義再代入

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n02.text: *Match symbols to their meanings before substitution*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n04.text:
$\epsilon$：正容忍值，各量分別選擇
*positive tolerance selected for each quantity*

lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u03-p20-n05.text:
$N$：連續觀察步數
*number of consecutive monitored steps*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u03.name: KP03：停表準則是儀表而非最優證明
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u03.text: 停表準則是儀表而非最優證明

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n01.text: 線搜索固定方向，再試步長

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n02.text: *Line search fixes the direction and then tests step sizes*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n04.text:
① 算目前梯度，從 η=1 試起。
*1. Compute the current gradient and start with eta=1.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n05.text:
② 候選 loss 有下降嗎？
*2. Does the candidate loss decrease?*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p01-n06.text:
③ 沒降：η←η/2，再試；有降：接受並更新。
*3. If not, halve eta and retry; otherwise accept and update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n01.text: 同高的一大步被拒，減半才下降

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n02.text: *A large equal-loss step is rejected; halving gives descent*

image.alt:
f(w)=w²，w=3；f=9，梯度 2×3=6。
η=1：3−1×6=−3，損失 (−3)²=9，不下降。 (Use the quadratic loss at w=3: loss 9 and gradient 6.
With eta=1, the candidate is minus 3 with loss 9, so it does not decrease.)

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n05.text:
讀圖：橫軸 η，縱軸候選 loss。
*The x-axis shows eta; the y-axis shows candidate loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n06.text:
f(w)=w²，w=3；f=9，梯度 2×3=6。
η=1：3−1×6=−3，損失 (−3)²=9，不下降。
*Use the quadratic loss at w=3: loss 9 and gradient 6.*
*With eta=1, the candidate is minus 3 with loss 9, so it does not decrease.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p02-n07.text:
η=0.5：3−0.5×6=0，損失 0²=0；接受。
*With eta=0.5, the candidate is zero with loss zero; accept it.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n01.text: 練習：線搜索的候選損失條件要求什麼？

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n02.text: *What does the line-search loss condition require?*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n04.text:
線搜索式 (5) 的條件 $f(\mathbf{w}^{(k)}-\eta\nabla f(\mathbf{w}^{(k)}))\lt f(\mathbf{w}^{(k)})$ 要求什麼？
A. loss 必須上升
B. 沿梯度反方向更新後 loss 必須下降
C. 梯度範數為零
D. $\eta$ 必須等於 $L$
*What does the line-search loss condition require?*
*A. Loss must rise.*
*B. Loss must decrease after moving against the gradient.*
*C. The gradient norm must be zero.*
*D. Eta must equal L.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p03-n05.text:
提示：比較目前 loss 與候選 loss；不把位置改變當作改善。
*Hint: Compare current and candidate loss; a position change alone is not improvement.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n01.text: 嚴格下降測試先排除零梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n02.text: *A strict-descent test must handle zero gradients first*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p04-n06.text:
L-smooth 且梯度非零時，足夠小的正步長會下降。
*With L-smoothness and a nonzero gradient, sufficiently small positive steps decrease loss.*

若梯度為零，所有候選都不動；先交由停表判斷。
*If the gradient is zero, all candidates stay put; assess stopping first.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n01.text: 安全下降條件也包含倒數端點

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n02.text: *The safe descent bound includes the reciprocal endpoint*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n04.text:
更正：原式 η<1/L 是充分條件，非必要條件。
η=1/L 在非零梯度時仍嚴格下降。
*Correction: eta below 1/L is sufficient, not necessary.*
*At eta=1/L, a nonzero gradient still gives strict descent.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n05.text:
二次例 L=2，接受的 0.5 正好等於 1/L。
*For the quadratic example L=2, the accepted 0.5 equals 1/L.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p05-n06.text:
$$
f(\mathbf w-\eta\mathbf g)\le f(\mathbf w)-\eta(1-L\eta/2)\|\mathbf g\|_2^2,\quad \mathbf g=\nabla f(\mathbf w)
$$

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n01.text: 不降就對半砍，不先換方向

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n02.text: *If loss does not decrease, halve the step without changing direction*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p06-n04.text:
步子太大會跨過谷底；
先縮 η，再測同一方向。
*An oversized step can cross the valley.*
*Shrink eta and test the same direction again.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n01.text: 充分下降比只要有降更嚴格

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n02.text: *Sufficient decrease is stricter than any decrease*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n04.text:
Armijo 規則要求「充分下降」，不只 loss 變小。
*The Armijo rule requires sufficient decrease, not merely any reduction.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p07-n05.text:
Wolfe 條件再約束沿線方向導數，避免過小步長。
這些策略增加損失或梯度評估成本。
*Wolfe conditions also constrain the directional derivative to avoid overly small steps.*
*These strategies add loss or gradient evaluations.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n01.text: 外層決定繼續，內層決定步長

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n02.text: *The outer loop decides continuation; the inner loop selects a step*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n04.text:
外層：檢查 KP03 的停表準則。
*Outer loop: check the stopping criteria from KP03.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n05.text:
內層：固定 w 與梯度，測 η 並回溯。
*Inner loop: fix w and its gradient, test eta, and backtrack.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p08-n06.text:
接受後更新 w，回到外層重算梯度。
*After accepting a step, update w and recompute the gradient in the outer loop.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n01.text: 精確線搜索在已選方向上找最優步長

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n02.text: *Exact line search finds the best step along the chosen direction*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p09-n06.text:
本章把精確線搜索的梯度法稱為最陡下降。
η⁽ᵏ⁾ 是第 k 步的一維最優步長。
*This chapter calls gradient descent with exact line search steepest descent.*
*Eta at iteration k is the one-dimensional optimal step.*

搜尋正步長；求得後仍沿 −∇f 更新。
*Search over positive steps; the update still follows the negative gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n01.text: 二次例的沿線最小值可直接解出

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n02.text: *The quadratic example has a directly solvable line minimum*

image.alt: φ(η)=(3−6η)²≥0，最小值在平方項為零。 (The squared line objective is nonnegative, and its minimum occurs when the squared term is zero.)

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n05.text:
讀圖：橫軸 η，縱軸候選 loss。
*The x-axis shows eta; the y-axis shows candidate loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n06.text:
φ(η)=(3−6η)²≥0，最小值在平方項為零。
*The squared line objective is nonnegative, and its minimum occurs when the squared term is zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p10-n07.text:
3−6η=0，故 6η=3、η=3/6=0.5；
更新後 w=3−0.5×6=0。
*Solve 3 minus 6 eta equal to zero: eta is 3/6, or 0.5.*
*The updated position is 3 minus 0.5 times 6, equal to zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n01.text: 步長更精細，每次更新也更昂貴

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n02.text: *More careful steps also make each update more expensive*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n04.text:
固定 η：最簡單，但需選適當大小。
回溯：試候選損失，接受一個下降步長。
*Fixed eta is simple but needs suitable tuning.*
*Backtracking evaluates candidates and accepts a decreasing step.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p11-n05.text:
精確線搜索：解一維最小化，每步多做計算。
大型深度學習常改用排程或自適應步長。
*Exact line search solves a one-dimensional problem at extra cost.*
*Large-scale deep learning often uses schedules or adaptive steps.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n01.text: 試探比喻描述候選而非真正移動

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n02.text: *The trial analogy describes candidates rather than actual moves*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p12-n04.text:
原比喻：過馬路前試探車距，不合適就縮短。
侷限：數學試探可先算 loss，不必真的走出去。
*The source analogy tests a road-crossing distance and shortens it if unsuitable.*
*Limit: mathematical trials evaluate loss before making a real move.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n01.text: 原題：步長不滿足條件時來源如何處理？

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n02.text: *How does the source handle a step that fails the condition?*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n04.text:
線搜索中步長不滿足條件時，採取的策略是？
A. 步長加倍 $\eta\leftarrow 2\eta$
B. 步長減半 $\eta\leftarrow\eta/2$
C. 停止優化
D. 反轉梯度方向
*How does the source handle a step that fails the condition?*
*A. Double eta.*
*B. Halve eta.*
*C. Stop optimization.*
*D. Reverse the gradient direction.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p13-n05.text:
提示：保持目前位置與方向固定，只調候選距離。
*Hint: Keep the current position and direction fixed; adjust only the candidate distance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n01.text: 同方向不代表同樣的步長策略

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n02.text: *The same direction can use different step-size strategies*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n04.text:
誤解：線搜索和固定 GD 走不同方向。
*Misconception: line search and fixed-step gradient descent use different directions.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p14-n05.text:
更正：本章都沿 −∇f，差在 η 的選法。
「沿線最優」不等於「全域最優」。
*Correction: both follow the negative gradient here; they differ in choosing eta.*
*Optimality along a line is not global optimality.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n01.text: 固定方向，縮步長，接受後再更新

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n02.text: *Fix the direction, shrink the step, and update only after acceptance*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p15-n04.text:
不降就對半砍；降了才更新。
內層選距離，外層看何時停。
*Halve when loss does not decrease; update only after acceptance.*
*The inner loop selects distance; the outer loop decides when to stop.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n01.text: 原題：最陡下降與固定 GD 的主要差異為何？

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n02.text: *What is the source’s main distinction between steepest descent and fixed-step gradient descent?*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n04.text:
最陡下降（式 (7)）與固定學習率梯度下降的主要差異是？
A. 更新方向不同
B. 每步用一維優化解出使 $f$ 最小的 $\eta^{(k)}$
C. 不使用梯度
D. 只用二階方法
*What is the source’s main distinction between steepest descent and fixed-step gradient descent?*
*A. They use different update directions.*
*B. Each step solves a one-dimensional problem for the minimizing eta.*
*C. They do not use gradients.*
*D. They only use second-order methods.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p16-n05.text:
提示：依本章的精確線搜索用法比較，不改動已選方向。
*Hint: Use this chapter’s exact-line-search convention and keep the chosen direction fixed.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n01.text: 候選只是試算，不先移動位置

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n02.text: *A candidate is a trial calculation, not an immediate move*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p17-n04.text:
先固定現在位置；
每個候選都從同一位置出發。
*Keep the current position fixed.*
*Every candidate starts from that same position.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n01.text: 移到另一個谷底再做減半表

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n02.text: *Repeat the halving table for a shifted valley*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n04.text:
練習：f(w)=(w−1)²、w=5，梯度 8、loss 16。
先試 η=1，不下降就減半，直到成立。
*Practice: use the shifted quadratic at w=5, with gradient 8 and loss 16.*
*Start with eta=1 and halve it until loss decreases.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p18-n05.text:
提示：候選 w新=5−8η；檢查 (w新−1)²<16。
*Hint: the candidate position is 5 minus 8 eta; compare its shifted squared loss with 16.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n01.text: 步長判準與梯度算法各司其職

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n02.text: *Step criteria and gradient algorithms have distinct roles*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p19-n04.text:
鏈式法則算梯度；
下降判準選步長。
*The chain rule computes gradients.*
*Descent criteria choose step sizes.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n01.text: 原題：Armijo 規則屬於哪類方法？

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n02.text: *What type of method does the Armijo rule belong to?*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n04.text:
Armijo 規則屬於哪類方法？
A. 反向傳播
B. 進階線搜索策略（充分下降條件）
C. 激活函數
D. 資料增強
*What type of method does the Armijo rule belong to?*
*A. Backpropagation.*
*B. An advanced line-search strategy requiring sufficient decrease.*
*C. An activation function.*
*D. Data augmentation.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p20-n05.text:
提示：辨認它判斷的是梯度計算、候選步長，還是資料處理。
*Hint: Identify whether it concerns gradient calculation, candidate steps, or data processing.*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n01.text: 符號先對照意義再代入

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n02.text: *Match symbols to their meanings before substitution*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n05.text:
$\eta^{(k)}$：第k步選出的步長
*step chosen at iteration k*

lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u04-p21-n06.text:
$\phi(\eta)$：沿固定方向的目標函數
*objective along a fixed direction*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u04.name: KP04：線搜索試步長，不降就減半
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u04.text: 線搜索試步長，不降就減半

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n01.text: 動量記住上一推，梯度仍看當前點

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n02.text: Gradient descent uses only the current slope.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p01-n04.text:
純梯度下降只看腳下坡度。在狹長山谷中，它可能左右來回。動量保留上一推的一部分，再加上本次下坡位移。它改變更新規則，不取代梯度計算。
*Gradient descent uses only the current slope. Momentum adds a fraction of the previous displacement to the current downhill step.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n01.text: 同一起點比較路徑，先看曲率差

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n02.text: The demo has 25 times more curvature along y.

image.alt: Demo 使用 f(x,y)=½(x²+25y²)，梯度為 (x,25y)。y 方向曲率是 x 的 25 倍。η=0.060、α=0.80，跑 40 步。圖中起點設為 (2,1)，是重建圖的明示條件，並非未知原圖資料。 本組參數動量的初期側向震盪反而較大；較快的長向收斂不代表每步更平滑。 / The demo has 25 times more curvature along y. Our reconstructed plot starts at (2,1), uses a learning rate of 0.060 and momentum 0.80, and runs 40 steps. These parameters produce larger early sideways oscillations with momentum; faster progress along x does not mean a smoother path at every step.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p02-n05.text:
Demo 使用 f(x,y)=½(x²+25y²)，梯度為 (x,25y)。y 方向曲率是 x 的 25 倍。η=0.060、α=0.80，跑 40 步。圖中起點設為 (2,1)，是重建圖的明示條件，並非未知原圖資料。 本組參數動量的初期側向震盪反而較大；較快的長向收斂不代表每步更平滑。
*The demo has 25 times more curvature along y. Our reconstructed plot starts at (2,1), uses a learning rate of 0.060 and momentum 0.80, and runs 40 steps. These parameters produce larger early sideways oscillations with momentum; faster progress along x does not mean a smoother path at every step.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n01.text: 兩項分開計算，才能看見側向相消

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n02.text: Separate the downhill step from the retained displacement.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p03-n04.text:
祕笈例：α=0.9、η=0.1、上一位移 (1.0,0.4)，當前梯度 (−0.5,6.0)。先算下坡項與歷史項，再相加：前進 0.95，側向 −0.24。提示練習：改 α=0.8、η=0.2、上一位移 (0.5,−0.4)、梯度 (1,2)，先拆成兩項。
*Separate the downhill step from the retained displacement. In the guide example they add to (0.95,-0.24). For practice, change the four inputs and add the two terms separately.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n01.text: 零初始慣性使第一步等於純梯度下降

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n02.text: Keep the conditions with the conclusion.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n04.text:
令前一步位移 Δw⁽⁻¹⁾=0。
*A zero initial previous displacement makes the first update identical to gradient descent.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p04-n05.text:
則第一步只剩 −η∇f。當 α=0 時每一步都退回純 GD。祕笈把「第零步位移=0」稱為第一推相同；此處明確使用前一步索引，避免一個索引代表兩件事。
*The first step then contains only the negative learning rate times the current gradient. With zero momentum, every step reduces to gradient descent. The guide calls a zero displacement at step zero the same first push; here we explicitly index the previous displacement to avoid giving one index two meanings.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n01.text: 購物車比喻只解釋記憶，不保證加速

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n02.text: Compare the assumptions before using the result.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n04.text:
原比喻是推車透過又長又窄的超市走道。前進分力可累積，撞架分力可能相消；也像推嬰兒車下緩坡石階。
*The original analogy is a shopping cart in a narrow aisle, or a stroller on a sloping stairway.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p05-n05.text:
侷限：數學更新沒有真實摩擦、貨架或碰撞；側向不一定每步相消。
*It illustrates memory, but physical collisions and friction are absent from the mathematical update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n01.text: 把位移相加，並不等於改變當前梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n02.text: From (10,1), gradient descent reaches (10.05,0.40) while momentum reaches (10.95,0.76).

image.alt: 祕笈數值：當前位置 (10,1)。純 GD 到 (10.05,0.40)，動量到 (10.95,0.76)。x 位移 0.95/0.05=19 倍；y 位移絕對值由 0.60 降至 0.24。這是本例的位移比例，不是普遍收斂加速率。 / From (10,1), gradient descent reaches (10.05,0.40) while momentum reaches (10.95,0.76). The factor of nineteen describes this displacement only, not a universal convergence speedup.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p06-n05.text:
祕笈數值：當前位置 (10,1)。純 GD 到 (10.05,0.40)，動量到 (10.95,0.76)。x 位移 0.95/0.05=19 倍；y 位移絕對值由 0.60 降至 0.24。這是本例的位移比例，不是普遍收斂加速率。
*From (10,1), gradient descent reaches (10.05,0.40) while momentum reaches (10.95,0.76). The factor of nineteen describes this displacement only, not a universal convergence speedup.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n01.text: 動量可能越過谷底，也可能發散

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n02.text: Momentum is distinct from the learning rate.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n04.text:
α 不是學習率；η 才控制當前梯度項的尺度。α 接近 1 會保留較多歷史，可能過衝。
*Alpha is not the learning rate; eta scales the current-gradient term. An alpha close to one retains more history and may cause overshooting.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p07-n05.text:
動量不保證全域最小值。祕笈列 0.8–0.99 為例示範圍，不能當作每個問題的安全區間。
*Strong memory may overshoot or diverge, and it does not guarantee a global minimum. The guide range 0.8–0.99 is illustrative, not universally safe.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n01.text: 原圖是來源證據，重建圖另列條件

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n02.text: The source contour plot is preserved.

image.alt: 保留來源 Fig.2，對比有無動量的等高線軌跡。原始軌跡資料與起點未提供，因此不聲稱重建 40 步圖與原圖同資料。來源提及 Fig.3 的向量相加，已按祕笈數值重畫。 / The source contour plot is preserved. Its trajectory data and starting point are unavailable, so our analytic reconstruction is explicitly a separate demonstration.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p08-n05.text:
保留來源 Fig.2，對比有無動量的等高線軌跡。原始軌跡資料與起點未提供，因此不聲稱重建 40 步圖與原圖同資料。來源提及 Fig.3 的向量相加，已按祕笈數值重畫。
*The source contour plot is preserved. Its trajectory data and starting point are unavailable, so our analytic reconstruction is explicitly a separate demonstration.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n01.text: 低通濾波直覺要附上成立條件

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n02.text: Persistent directions can accumulate, while alternating directions may cancel.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n04.text:
當梯度方向連續多步一致，歷史項會累積；當某分量交替變號，歷史項可能抵消。
*When gradient directions persist across consecutive steps, historical contributions accumulate. When a component alternates in sign, its historical contributions may cancel.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p09-n05.text:
這是低通濾波直覺。線搜尋改本步步長，動量改跨步記憶；反傳算梯度。RMSProp/Adam 另累積平方或一階矩。
*This motivates a low-pass filtering analogy. Line search changes a step length, whereas momentum remembers earlier steps.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n01.text: 歷史歸屬需要勘誤，不能照抄最早

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n02.text: Polyak published a relevant momentum method in 1964.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n04.text:
來源把動量最早歸給 Rumelhart 等人。已有 Polyak 1964 原論文，故「最早」說法不成立。
*Polyak published a relevant momentum method in 1964.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p10-n05.text:
保留原歷史題供勘誤討論，不把原選項 B 當成正確歷史答案。
*The source attribution of its earliest origin to Rumelhart and colleagues needs correction. The original quiz is retained for discussion.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n01.text: 符號先對應意義，再代入公式

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n02.text: Identify each symbol and its role before calculating.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n05.text:
迭代索引，從零開始
*Iteration index, starting at zero*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n07.text:
第 k 步參數向量
*Parameter vector at iteration k*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p11-n09.text:
本步位移向量
*Current displacement vector*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n01.text: 先定義角色，才能解讀下一組符號

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n02.text: Parameters, outputs, and gradients play different roles.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p12-n04.text:
參數、輸出與梯度各有不同角色；不要只憑字母形狀代入。
*Parameters, outputs, and gradients play different roles.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n01

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n07

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p13-n09.text:
損失對參數的梯度向量
*Gradient of the loss with respect to parameters*

式 (8) 中 α 的角色是？
*What does alpha represent in equation (8)?*

A. 學習率

*Momentum coefficient controlling retained displacement*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p18-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p18-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p18-n04.text:
動量對最佳化路徑的主要效果是？
*What is the main path effect of momentum?*

A. 保證找到全域最小值
*Guarantees a global minimum*
B. 減少狹長山谷震盪、加速收斂
*Can reduce ravine oscillations and accelerate convergence*
C. 完全取代梯度
*Completely replaces the gradient*
D. 固定學習率不變
*Keeps the learning rate fixed*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p18-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p18-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p18-n05.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p19-n01.text: 先用條件核對下一題的選項

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p19-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p19-n02

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p19-n04.text:
把 α 設為零，再比較兩式。
*Set alpha to zero and compare the two updates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n01.text: 原題4：式 (8) 與純梯度下降的關鍵差異？

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n02.text: What distinguishes equation (8) from gradient descent?

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n04.text:
式 (8) 與純梯度下降的關鍵差異？
*What distinguishes equation (8) from gradient descent?*

A. 多 αΔw 的歷史項
*Adds a retained displacement term*
B. 不用梯度
*Uses no gradient*
C. 只用上一步、不用當前梯度
*Uses only the previous step*
D. 完全相同
*They are identical*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p20-n05.text:
提示：把 α 設為零，再比較兩式。
*Hint: Set alpha to zero and compare the two updates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n01.text: 先驗算第一步，再讀四十步終點

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n02.text: Check the first step before the endpoint.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p21-n04.text:
起點 (2,1)、上一位移零，使純 GD 與動量第一步相同；後續纔有歷史項。
*Both methods start at (2,1) with zero previous displacement, so their first steps match.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n01.text: 四十步終點是程式迭代結果

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n02.text: The endpoints come from repeated analytic updates.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p22-n04.text:
〔程式計算〕重複同一閉式40次，GD終點約 (0.1683232623,0)，動量約 (−0.0225968155,0.0140959642)；距原點約0.1683232623與0.0266329172。α=0兩軌跡完全重合。
*(computed) Repeating the analytic update forty times gives GD endpoint (0.1683232623,0) and momentum endpoint (-0.0225968155,0.0140959642). Their distances are 0.1683232623 and 0.0266329172. Alpha zero gives identical paths.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n01.text: 先保留舊值，再形成下一步

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n02.text: The order keeps every value at the correct state.

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n04.text:
每次更新都先指定當前參數。動量額外保存前一次位移，新的位移算完才移動參數。
*Each update starts from the current parameters. Retain the previous displacement, compute the new displacement, and then move the parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n05.text:
當前參數
*Read the current parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n06.text:
梯度與舊位移
*Compute the gradient and retain memory.*

lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n08.name: lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n08
lec03-bp-v2-u05-p23-n08.text:
下一參數
*Move to the next parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u05.name: KP05：動量把歷史位移加進本步更新
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u05.text: 動量把歷史位移加進本步更新

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n01.text: 前向產生輸出，反向傳回敏感度

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n02.text: Evaluate the entire forward pass with one parameter state.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n04.text:
先用同一組權重算完前向輸出與損失。反向從出口回傳 δ，得到各權重梯度。鍋爐房比喻：先向前送蒸汽，再反向傳話。最後才由最佳化器決定如何調整權重。
*Evaluate the entire forward pass with one parameter state. Propagate sensitivities backward to compute all gradients, then let the optimizer update the parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p01-n07.text:
出口與損失
*The output defines the loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n01.text: 權重梯度等於本層敏感度乘前層輸出

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n02.text: A neuron applies its activation to a weighted input.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p02-n04.text:
i 接收前層輸出 zℓ，先算加權和 aᵢ，再經 σᵢ 得 zᵢ。δᵢ 定義為 ∂e/∂aᵢ。因 ∂aᵢ/∂wᵢℓ=zℓ，鏈式法則得到梯度 δᵢzℓ。
*A neuron applies its activation to a weighted input. Define delta as sensitivity to preactivation. The chain rule gives the weight gradient as delta times the previous output.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n01.text: 預設小網路的兩個梯度是二與一

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n02.text: With input and weights all one, a squared hidden activation gives loss 0.5.

image.alt: 令入口、兩權重都為 1，目標 t=0，隱藏 σ(a)=a²，出口恆等。前向得到 aᵢ=zᵢ=zⱼ=1、e=0.5。出口 δⱼ=1；隱藏 δᵢ=1×1×2=2，故隱藏梯度 2、出口梯度 1。 / With input and weights all one, a squared hidden activation gives loss 0.5. The output gradient is one and the hidden gradient is two.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p03-n05.text:
令入口、兩權重都為 1，目標 t=0，隱藏 σ(a)=a²，出口恆等。前向得到 aᵢ=zᵢ=zⱼ=1、e=0.5。出口 δⱼ=1；隱藏 δᵢ=1×1×2=2，故隱藏梯度 2、出口梯度 1。
*With input and weights all one, a squared hidden activation gives loss 0.5. The output gradient is one and the hidden gradient is two.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n01.text: 先鎖定舊權重，再練習整次更新

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n02.text: Work through the example in order.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n04.text:
練習：zℓ=2、wᵢℓ=0.5、wⱼᵢ=2、t=3、η=0.05，隱藏 σ(a)=a²、出口恆等。依序算前向、兩個 δ、兩個梯度與新權重。提示：反傳時使用舊的出口權重 2。
*Use input two, hidden weight 0.5, output weight two, target three, and learning rate 0.05. Compute the full forward and backward passes before updating either weight.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p04-n05.text:
提示：先標參數時點，再逐步代入。
*Hint: label the parameter state before substituting values.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n01.text: 單一神經元先加總，再經激活函式

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n02.text: The index m counts previous-layer inputs.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p05-n04.text:
式 (9) 的 m 是前層輸入數。若需要偏置，可把常數輸入 z₀=1 接上權重；本來源例子未額外設偏置。神經元示意圖保留加權輸入、加總與激活的角色。
*The index m counts previous-layer inputs. A constant input can represent a bias, although the source example introduces no separate bias parameter.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n01.text: 隱藏敏感度要加總所有下游路徑

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n02.text: A hidden output may affect several downstream neurons.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p06-n04.text:
隱藏層的輸出可能影響多個 j。鏈式法則要把每一條路徑貢獻相加：先把下游 δⱼ 乘 wⱼᵢ，再乘本層 σ′(aᵢ)。只取一個下游會漏算，漏乘激活導數也會錯。
*A hidden output may affect several downstream neurons. Sum every downstream contribution and multiply by the local activation derivative.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n01.text: 把隱藏敏感度代回，即得權重梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n02.text: Equations (15) and (16) reorganize the same chain rule.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p07-n04.text:
式 (15) 與式 (16) 是同一條鏈式法則的兩種整理。
*Equations (15) and (16) reorganize the same chain rule.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n01.text: 把隱藏敏感度代回，即得權重梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n02.text: Equations (15) and (16) reorganize the same chain rule.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p08-n04.text:
式 (15) 與式 (16) 是同一條鏈式法則的兩種整理。σ′(aᵢ) 是神經元本地導數，Σⱼδⱼwⱼᵢ 是下游回傳資訊，zℓ 是這根權重前的輸入。
*Equations (15) and (16) reorganize the same chain rule. They combine the local derivative, downstream sensitivities, and the input attached to the weight.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n01.text: 反傳只求導，最佳化器另決定更新

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n02.text: Backpropagation computes derivatives at the old parameter state.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n04.text:
所有梯度都必須在 w⁽ᵏ⁾ 計算。
*Backpropagation computes derivatives at the old parameter state.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p09-n05.text:
更新式 (17)–(19) 是梯度下降的使用方式，不是反傳的定義。也可把同樣的梯度交給動量或 Adam。
*Gradient descent, momentum, or Adam can then use those derivatives.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n01.text: 輸出與隱藏更新形式不同，時點相同

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n02.text: Output delta depends on the loss and output activation.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n04.text:
輸出層 δ 可由損失及輸出激活求出；它不總是 z−t。祕笈恆等出口加平方損失纔有 δⱼ=zⱼ−t。
*Output delta is derived from the loss and output activation; it is not always prediction minus target. That residual formula holds in the guide because the output is the identity and the loss is squared error.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p10-n05.text:
隱藏層用回傳式。兩式右側參數一律取更新前值。
*It equals prediction minus target in this specific identity-output squared-loss example. All right-hand values are evaluated before updating.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p11-n01.text: 倒序是求導順序，不是邊求邊改

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p11-n04.text:
Algorithm 2 的安全版本：初始化→前向→由最後層回到第一層求 δ 與梯度→一次更新全部權重→檢查停止條件。未停止則按選定規則調整 η 並繼續。來源若解讀為先改出口再回傳，會用錯參數點。
*The safe algorithm initializes parameters, evaluates forward, computes gradients backward, updates all parameters, and checks a stopping condition. Reverse traversal does not authorize premature updates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n01.text: 下游有誤差，上游也可能收到零梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n04.text:
反例：兩出口 δ₁=1、δ₂=−1，且兩連線權重皆 1。加權和 1×1+(−1)×1=0，因此本層 δᵢ=0，梯度也為零。
*For two outputs with sensitivities one and minus one and both connecting weights one, the weighted sum is zero. The hidden sensitivity and its weight gradient are therefore zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p13-n05.text:
反傳傳的是有正負的敏感度，不是責備的程度。
*With values one and minus one and unit weights, their sum is zero, so the hidden gradient can vanish despite downstream errors.*
