lec03-bp-v2-u06-p29-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p29-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p29-n01.text: 先算激活前，再平方成輸出

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p29-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p29-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p29-n04.text:
入口 zℓ、隱藏權重與出口權重皆為1，目標0。先求隱藏激活前輸入與輸出，再求本地導數；此時不更新權重。
*Input, hidden weight, and output weight are one; target zero. Compute hidden preactivation, output, and local derivative without updating.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n01.text: 恆等出口加平方損失，纔得到殘差敏感度

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n02.text: This output sensitivity follows from the selected loss.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p30-n04.text:
本例出口激活是恆等，故 ∂zⱼ/∂aⱼ=1；輸出敏感度 δⱼ=(zⱼ−t)×1=1。換損失或激活後，要重做這一步鏈式法則。
*The identity output has derivative one, giving output delta one. A different loss or output activation changes this chain-rule step.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n01.text: 兩個梯度共享更新前的權重一

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n02.text: Both gradients use the same old weights.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p31-n04.text:
出口敏感度1乘隱藏輸出1，得到出口梯度1；隱藏敏感度1×1×2再乘入口1，得到隱藏梯度2。然後才同時得到新權重0.9與0.8。
*The output gradient is one times one. The hidden gradient is one times one times two times one. Only then are the weights updated to 0.9 and 0.8.*

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n01.text: 同一舊參數算完，才能一起更新

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n02.text: Dependencies determine derivative order; the optimizer determines when parameters change.

lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u06-p32-n04.text:
梯度的運算順序由依賴決定，更新時點由優化器決定。
*Dependencies determine derivative order; the optimizer determines when parameters change.*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u06.name: KP06：反向傳播先算全部梯度，再更新參數
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u06.text: 反向傳播先算全部梯度，再更新參數

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n01.text: 全資料平均改成均勻抽一筆估計

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n02.text: The objective averages all example losses.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p01-n04.text:
總損失 f 是 n 筆 fᵢ 的平均。全梯度需要 n 個樣本梯度；單樣本 SGD 每步均勻隨機抽一筆，以該梯度替代平均。每步便宜，但一次抽樣可能偏離全梯度。
*The objective averages all example losses. Uniform single-sample SGD substitutes one gradient for the full average, reducing per-step work but adding sampling noise.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n01.text: Demo 的四筆目標平均是四

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n02.text: The demo targets are (2,1,8,5), with mean four.

image.alt: Demo 目標 y=(2,1,8,5)，fᵢ(w)=½(w−yᵢ)²，∇fᵢ=w−yᵢ。在 w=0、η=0.2，全梯度 −4 更新至 0.8；抽第 1 筆梯度 −2 更新至 0.4。不要與祕笈另一組目標混用。 / The demo targets are (2,1,8,5), with mean four. From zero at learning rate 0.2, the full-gradient update reaches 0.8 and sample one reaches 0.4.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p02-n05.text:
Demo 目標 y=(2,1,8,5)，fᵢ(w)=½(w−yᵢ)²，∇fᵢ=w−yᵢ。在 w=0、η=0.2，全梯度 −4 更新至 0.8；抽第 1 筆梯度 −2 更新至 0.4。不要與祕笈另一組目標混用。
*The demo targets are (2,1,8,5), with mean four. From zero at learning rate 0.2, the full-gradient update reaches 0.8 and sample one reaches 0.4.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n01.text: 單次方向可錯，期望仍可能正確

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n02.text: For targets (1,3,5), parameter two, and learning rate 0.5, compute each sample update.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n04.text:
練習：t=(1,3,5)、w=2、η=0.5。先算三個 w−tᵢ、平均梯度，再算抽每一筆的新 w。提示：先找平均目標 w*=3，檢查每步是否更接近它；期望正確不保證每一筆都對。
*For targets (1,3,5), parameter two, and learning rate 0.5, compute each sample update. Compare its distance to the mean target three; unbiasedness does not guarantee every realized step improves.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p03-n05.text:
提示：先標參數時點，再逐步代入。
*Hint: label the parameter state before substituting values.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n01.text: 均勻抽樣是無偏梯度的前提

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n02.text: Compute each term before combining them.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p04-n04.text:
在固定 w，每個索引機率為 1/n，故期望等於平均。若偏向某些樣本而未校正權重，這個等式未必成立。SGD 每步成本約一筆模型前反向，full-batch 約 n 筆；成本還依模型大小而變。
*At a fixed parameter state, uniform sampling makes the expected sample gradient equal the full gradient. Nonuniform sampling without correction need not preserve this equality.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n01.text: 帳單與試喫比喻只說明抽樣估計

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n02.text: The bill and tasting analogies explain sampling.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n04.text:
原比喻：用一張公司帳單估全公司平均；替換場景：餐廳夾一口估全選單鹹度。
*The original analogy estimates the company average from one bill. Its alternative estimates the average saltiness of the whole restaurant menu by tasting one bite.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p05-n05.text:
侷限：均勻隨機才代表平均，便利抽樣可能偏。參數每次改變，因此不是把同一固定帳單總額直接相加。
*A convenient rather than uniformly random sample may be biased, and the parameter changes after each update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n01.text: 祕笈另用四張帳單，平均是五

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n02.text: The guide uses different targets, (2,4,6,8), with mean five.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p06-n04.text:
祕笈目標 t=(2,4,6,8)，故 w*=5。在 w=0，梯度為 −2、−4、−6、−8，平均 −5。η=0.2：full-batch 到 1.0，抽第1筆到 0.4，抽第4筆到 1.6。這是另一個算例。
*The guide uses different targets, (2,4,6,8), with mean five. At zero, sample gradients are -2,-4,-6,-8. The full update reaches one; samples one and four reach 0.4 and 1.6.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n01.text: 在平均最優點，單筆梯度仍會抖

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n02.text: At the guide optimum five, gradients are (3,1,-1,-3).

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n04.text:
在祕笈 w*=5，各梯度為 3、1、−1、−3，平均為零。抽第1筆仍會把 w 改成 5−0.2×3=4.4。
*At the guide optimum five, gradients are (3,1,-1,-3).*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p07-n05.text:
這不是無偏等式失敗，而是單次估計有非零方差。
*Their mean is zero, yet sampling the first example moves the parameter to 4.4 because individual gradients remain noisy.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n01.text: 學習率排程隨步數變，不一定自適應

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n02.text: The source lists inverse-step, inverse-square-root, and constant learning rates.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n04.text:
來源列 ηᵏ=1/k、1/√k、固定 η。
*The source lists inverse-step, inverse-square-root, and constant learning rates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p08-n05.text:
前兩式從 k=1 起定義，不能在 k=0 除零。它們是預先指定排程；自適應通常指依資料或梯度狀態調整，兩者不要混稱。
*The first two begin at step one. A predefined schedule should be distinguished from gradient-adaptive rates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n01.text: 三種排程的差別要由數字看

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n02.text: Read the inputs before comparing the curves.

image.alt: k=1,4,9,16 時，1/k 為 1,0.25,0.1111,0.0625；1/√k 為 1,0.5,0.3333,0.25；固定為 0.2。來源四捨五入 0.063 對應 0.0625。衰減較慢不代表任何問題都更好。 / At steps 1,4,9,16, the inverse-step and inverse-square-root schedules shrink at different speeds. The source value 0.063 rounds the exact value 0.0625.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p09-n05.text:
k=1,4,9,16 時，1/k 為 1,0.25,0.1111,0.0625；1/√k 為 1,0.5,0.3333,0.25；固定為 0.2。來源四捨五入 0.063 對應 0.0625。衰減較慢不代表任何問題都更好。
*At steps 1,4,9,16, the inverse-step and inverse-square-root schedules shrink at different speeds. The source value 0.063 rounds the exact value 0.0625.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n01.text: 便宜一步不保證更少步或必然收斂

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n02.text: Lower per-step cost does not guarantee fewer iterations.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n04.text:
單步計算少，並不保證比 full-batch 更少迭代。固定步長下可能留有雜訊誤差；O(η) 必須說清是何種誤差與假設，不能當普遍參數距離。
*Less computation per step does not guarantee fewer iterations than full-batch updating. A fixed learning rate may leave noise-related error. An error of order eta requires a specified error measure and assumptions; it is not a universal parameter-distance bound.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p10-n05.text:
1/√k 也不滿足經典平方可和條件，不能單靠排程保證收斂。
*Constant-rate error bounds require assumptions and a specified error measure. A schedule alone cannot establish convergence.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n01.text: 單樣本與小批次都常被簡稱 SGD

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n02.text: This unit uses SGD strictly for one example per step.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n04.text:
本節嚴格使用 single-sample SGD，一步一筆。
*This unit uses SGD strictly for one example per step.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p11-n05.text:
實務常把 mini-batch SGD 也叫 SGD。每筆梯度可由反傳取得；下一單元只改抽樣與平均筆數，不改反傳規則。來源「ML 約1998開始」不當作最早年份。
*Common usage also includes mini-batches. Backpropagation computes the example gradients; sampling changes how many are averaged.*

參數、輸出與梯度各有不同角色；不要只憑字母形狀代入。

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p15-n01.text: 原題1：式 (20) 總 cost 如何定義？

A. 單一樣本 loss
*One sample loss*

C. n 個 loss 最大值

D. 不含資料項

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p17-n02.text: What distinguishes SGD from full-batch updating?

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p17-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p17-n04.text:
SGD 與 full-batch 的關鍵差異？
*What distinguishes SGD from full-batch updating?*

A. 用單樣本梯度而非全梯度
*Uses one sample gradient instead of the full gradient*
B. 不用梯度
*Uses no gradient*
C. 一定收斂更快
*Always converges faster*
D. 每步掃完整資料集

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p19-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p19-n04

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p20-n04.text:
固定模型一次梯度的成本，再數要算幾筆。
*Hold model cost fixed and count the examples evaluated.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n01.text: 原題4：Full-batch 成本隨 n 如何變？

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n02.text: How does full-gradient work scale with n?

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n04.text:
Full-batch 成本隨 n 如何變？
*How does full-gradient work scale with n?*

A. 每步全部 n 筆求和，O(n)
*Sums all n examples, with linear work*
B. 與 n 無關
*Independent of n*
C. 只需一筆
*Needs one example*
D. 只需輸出層
*Needs only the output layer*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p21-n05.text:
提示：固定模型一次梯度的成本，再數要算幾筆。
*Hint: Hold model cost fixed and count the examples evaluated.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n01.text: 祕笈三種更新逐一代入同一步長

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n02.text: Substitute the same rate into each guide update.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p22-n04.text:
本頁只用祕笈 t=(2,4,6,8)。不要拿Demo平均4的全梯度−4代入；此處平均5的全梯度是−5。
*This page uses only guide targets (2,4,6,8), with mean five. The demo mean four belongs to a different example.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n01.text: 步數十六時，兩排程仍不同

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n02.text: The two schedules remain different at step sixteen.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p23-n04.text:
固定排程仍是0.2；原表的0.063是0.0625四捨五入。表中所有值以k=1,4,9,16代入各式，並非跟著模型梯度調整的自適應步長。
*The constant rate remains 0.2. The source value 0.063 rounds 0.0625. These rates follow the iteration index rather than adapt to model gradients.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n01.text: 抽樣改的是梯度來源，更新骨架不變

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n02.text: The order keeps every value at the correct state.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n04.text:
從資料集均勻抽一筆，對這筆資料前向與反傳，然後用它的梯度更新參數。
*Draw one example uniformly, compute its forward and backward passes, and then update using its gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n06.text:
均勻抽一筆
*Draw one example uniformly.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n07.text:
前向與反傳
*Evaluate forward and backward.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n08.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n08
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p24-n08.text:
參數更新
*Use this gradient to update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n01.text: 均勻抽樣的期望，不是單步保證

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n02.text: A sample may differ from the mean direction; unbiasedness does not promise improvement at every step.

lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u07-p25-n04.text:
單樣本可以偏離平均方向，不能把期望等式理解成每步都好。
*A sample may differ from the mean direction; unbiasedness does not promise improvement at every step.*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u07.name: KP07：單樣本梯度以便宜換取抽樣雜訊
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u07.text: 單樣本梯度以便宜換取抽樣雜訊

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n01.text: 一小疊平均梯度，掃完資料算一輪

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n04.text:
每次拿 b 筆平均，比一筆穩定、比全部便宜。無放回切成互斥批次，全部用過一次是 epoch。若 n=1024、b=32，每輪有 1024/32=32 次更新。b 不整除 n 時，需保留最後小批次或明示捨棄。
*A mini-batch averages several gradients. An epoch processes the dataset once. With 1024 examples and batch size 32, an epoch has 32 updates; an incomplete final batch requires an explicit policy.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n06.text:
全部梯度求完
*Compute every gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n08.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n08
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p01-n08.text:
下一疊重算
*Recompute the next batch.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n01.text: 第二疊必須在新的參數重新求梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n02.text: Compute each term before combining them.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p02-n04.text:
祕笈 t=(2,4,6,8)、w=5、η=0.5。第一疊索引 {1,2} 平均梯度 (3+1)/2=2，w→4。第二疊 {3,4} 此時梯度為 4−6=−2、4−8=−4，平均 −3，故 w→5.5。原文回到5使用過期梯度，有錯。
*After the first batch moves the parameter from five to four, recompute the second batch gradients as -2 and -4. Its mean -3 moves the parameter to 5.5, correcting the source result five.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n01.text: 先寫實際批次大小，再做一次更新

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n02.text: For six given gradients at parameter one, choose a batch of three and compute one update.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n04.text:
練習：n=6，當前 w=1 時梯度暫記 6,4,2,0,−2,−4，b=3、η=0.1。先算批次數，再選第一疊更新。提示：只給某點梯度不足以算第二疊的新梯度；若假設平方損失，需明示目標纔可走完一輪。
*For six given gradients at parameter one, choose a batch of three and compute one update. To continue the epoch, specify how gradients change with the parameter; the given values alone are insufficient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p03-n05.text:
提示：先標參數時點，再逐步代入。
*Hint: label the parameter state before substituting values.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n01.text: 覆蓋全集合的切法需要處理餘數

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n02.text: The source floor-count partition covers the dataset only when b divides n.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n04.text:
來源式 (23)–(24) 使用 floor(n/b) 個大小 b 的批次。
*The source floor-count partition covers the dataset only when b divides n.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p04-n05.text:
只有 b 整除 n，聯集纔等於 D。保留尾批時應有 ceil(n/b) 批，最後批大小 n−b floor(n/b)。捨棄尾批則本輪未掃到所有資料。
*Retaining an incomplete batch uses a ceiling count; dropping it leaves some examples unused.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n01.text: 尾批平均要除以當批實際筆數

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n02.text: A complete batch uses divisor b, while a smaller final batch uses its actual size.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p05-n04.text:
式 (25) 對完整大小 b 的批次除以 b；尾批有 mₖ 筆則除以 mₖ。平均與求和方向相同，但沿用 η 時，求和把步長放大 mₖ 倍。GPU 可平行算同一批，效率仍受硬體與模型限制。
*A complete batch averages b examples; the last batch averages its actual size m_k. Sums and means have the same direction, but with unchanged eta, summing multiplies the update by m_k. GPUs can evaluate a batch in parallel; efficiency still depends on hardware and the model.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n01.text: 一疊一疊改卷只說明運算節奏

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n02.text: The grading and factory-inspection analogies illustrate processing cadence.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n04.text:
原比喻：一張就改評分標準太吵，全班改完才調太慢；改 b 張再調是折衷。替換場景是工廠每箱抽檢後調機臺。
*The original analogy changes grading rules after one paper, which is noisy, or after the whole class, which is slow. Updating after b papers is the compromise. The alternative adjusts factory machinery after inspecting each box.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p06-n05.text:
侷限：此處參數不是現實學生評分規則；不應把最佳化器的變動當成教學評分建議。
*Optimizer parameters are not real grading rules, and the analogy does not recommend changing student assessment standards.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n01.text: 小批次誤差是近似梯度減全梯度

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n02.text: Define gradient error as the batch average minus the full average at the same parameter.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n04.text:
在固定參數 w⁽ᵗ⁾，定義 batch 平均 ḡ_B 與全資料平均 ḡ，兩者差 eₜ。
*Define gradient error as the batch average minus the full average at the same parameter.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p07-n05.text:
均勻新抽的 batch 期望誤差零；隨機重排中後續批次與已更新參數相依，不能直接套用每步條件無偏。
*Fresh uniform sampling has zero expected error; later shuffled batches can depend on previous updates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n01.text: 方差分母用資料數，無放回要加修正

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n02.text: Compute each term before combining them.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p08-n04.text:
令 σ²=(1/n)Σ||gᵢ−ḡ||²。獨立有放回抽 b 次，均值方差為 σ²/b。無放回均勻抽 b 個不同索引，則為 [(n−b)/(n−1)]σ²/b。原式 (29) 的 (1−b/n) 適用於另一分母定義，不能混用。
*With population variance defined using divisor n, independent replacement sampling gives variance sigma-squared over b. Without replacement, multiply by (n-b)/(n-1), not by one minus b/n.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n01.text: 另一種方差定義可還原原式係數

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n02.text: Using divisor n-1 gives S-squared instead.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p09-n04.text:
若 S²=(1/(n−1))Σ||gᵢ−ḡ||²，則 S²=nσ²/(n−1)，無放回方差可以寫 (1−b/n)S²/b。兩種寫法是同一結果；有放回卻仍是 σ²/b，不能同時把兩式的 σ²都當 S²。
*Using divisor n-1 gives S-squared instead. The source finite-population factor is then valid with S-squared, while replacement sampling still uses population variance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n01.text: 四筆例子的正確方差是五

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n02.text: At fixed parameter five, the four gradients have population variance five.

image.alt: 固定 w=5 時，g=(3,1,−1,−3)、平均0，σ²=(9+1+1+9)/4=5。b=1,2,4 的無放回方差為 5,5/3,0；有放回為5,2.5,1.25。來源3.75,1.25,0混用了分母，已勘誤。 / At fixed parameter five, the four gradients have population variance five. The correct no-replacement variances for batch sizes one, two, and four are five, five-thirds, and zero.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p10-n05.text:
固定 w=5 時，g=(3,1,−1,−3)、平均0，σ²=(9+1+1+9)/4=5。b=1,2,4 的無放回方差為 5,5/3,0；有放回為5,2.5,1.25。來源3.75,1.25,0混用了分母，已勘誤。
*At fixed parameter five, the four gradients have population variance five. The correct no-replacement variances for batch sizes one, two, and four are five, five-thirds, and zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n01.text: 無放回方差可由六種配對逐一驗算

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n02.text: The six equally likely pairs have means (2,1,0,0,-1,-2).

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p11-n04.text:
b=2 的六個不同索引對，平均梯度分別2,1,0,0,−1,−2。均值為0，平方平均(4+1+0+0+1+4)/6=5/3，與公式相符。這是一個固定 w 的抽樣比較，不是同一 epoch 的連續更新。
*The six equally likely pairs have means (2,1,0,0,-1,-2). Their squared mean is five-thirds. This compares samples at a fixed parameter, not successive updates within an epoch.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n01.text: 批次越大常降低雜訊，但步成本增加

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n02.text: Keep the conditions with the conclusion.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n04.text:
b=1 是單樣本，b=n 且無放回是全梯度。
*Batch size one recovers single-sample updates; all examples without replacement recover the full gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p12-n05.text:
在相同固定 w 下，有放回即使 b=n 也可重複漏樣本，方差未必零。來源列32,64,128,256作為例示起點；沒有萬能大小，要考慮記憶體與吞吐。
*At the same fixed parameter, sampling with replacement can repeat some examples and miss others even when b equals n, so variance need not vanish. The source lists 32,64,128,256 only as starting examples. No batch size is universally best; consider memory and throughput.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n01.text: 原收斂率缺誤差量與假設，先保留邊界

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n02.text: The stated condition prevents a common error.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n04.text:
來源式 (27) 為 O(1/t+||eₜ||²)，式 (28) 為 O((1−μ/L)ᵗ+||eₜ||²)。未說明非凸何種量、e 的歷史或界、η條件，因此不能作為通用定理。
*The source rate statements omit the measured error, learning-rate conditions, and treatment of gradient errors.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p13-n05.text:
保留原表達並標待覈對；非凸通常需明確梯度範數等指標。
*They are retained as unverified expressions, not universal convergence theorems.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n01.text: 一輪結束不保證回到原點或全批結果

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n02.text: The corrected guide trajectory is five to four to 5.5.

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n04.text:
來源反轉稱5→4→5是空轉，已糾正為5→4→5.5。
*The corrected guide trajectory is five to four to 5.5.*

lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u08-p14-n05.text:
前後批次使用不同 w，不能把兩平均梯度當正負相消。順序改變可改變終點；epoch 是覆蓋節奏，不是一次 full-batch 更新的同義詞。

image.alt: Read the iteration axis, then compare decaying and constant terms. Curves use 10/(t+1), 10/t+0.5, and 10/t+0.05. These illustrative bounds are not measured losses or lower bounds.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p01-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p01-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p01-n05.text:
凸問題可量函數誤差；非凸問題通常量駐點量。圖中曲線只是上界形狀，沒有實測軌跡。固定步長的殘留上界，不是必然誤差下限。
*Convex analysis can bound objective error. Nonconvex analysis usually bounds stationarity. These curves illustrate bounds, not measured trajectories. A residual upper bound is not a necessary error floor.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p01-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p01-n06

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p02-n02.text: A toy bound retains a constant when the step size is fixed.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p02-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p02-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p02-n04.text:

*Use the illustrative bound B(t)=10/t+η. For t=99 and η=0.05, evaluate the decaying term first. This is an arithmetic example, not a measured loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p03-n04.text:
SGD 相對全梯度下降的主要優勢是？
*What is the main advantage of SGD over full-gradient descent?*
A. 更高的收斂精度
*A. Higher convergence accuracy*
B. 每次迭代的計算成本更低
*B. Lower computational cost per iteration*
C. 不需要選學習率
*C. No learning-rate selection*
D. 保證找到全局最優
*D. Guaranteed global optimality*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p03-n05.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n01.text: 上界不是一條不能跨過的牆

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n02.text: An upper bound is not an uncrossable lower barrier.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p04-n04.text:
口訣：先看量測量，再看假設。O(η) 表示長期保證的量級；沒有下界，就不能說永遠到不了最優。
*Read the error measure and assumptions first. O(η) describes the scale of a long-run guarantee. Without a lower bound, impossibility does not follow.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n01.text: 全梯度誤差保證需要凸與合適步長

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n02.text: Full-gradient objective guarantees require convexity and a suitable step size.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p05-n05.text:
凸且梯度 L-smooth，有最小化點，取 η=1/L。令 t≥0；來源式(31)是一個較寬鬆的函數誤差上界。它保證函數值逼近，不等於有限步到達。
*Assume convexity, an L-Lipschitz gradient, and an attained minimum. Use η=1/L and t≥0. Source equation (31) is a loose objective-error bound. It concerns asymptotic function values.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n01.text: 符號定義決定收斂敘述的意義

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n02.text: Symbol definitions determine what a convergence claim means.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n04.text:
梯度光滑表示斜率變化受限制；強凸表示函數具有正的曲率下界。期望是對抽樣取平均，不是單次軌跡。
*Smoothness limits changes in gradients. Strong convexity gives a positive curvature lower bound. Expectation averages sampling outcomes, not one trajectory.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n15.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n15
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p06-n15.text:

*Step size, second-moment bound, and expectation*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n01.text: 凸 SGD 要先建立無偏的梯度估計

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n02.text: Convex SGD first needs an unbiased gradient estimate.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p07-n05.text:
[補充／更正] 採 f=(1/n)Σfᵢ，均勻抽 i，則 g 是無偏估計。若用總和目標，應使用 ng。假設凸、存在 w*、且 E[‖gτ‖²|wτ]≤G²。
*[Added clarification] Use the average objective and uniform sampling. The sampled gradient is unbiased. A summed objective instead requires n times that gradient. Assume convexity, a minimizer, and bounded gradient second moments.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n01.text: 距離展開把凸誤差換成可加總的項

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n02.text: A distance expansion converts convex error into summable terms.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n04.text:
[補充／更正] 展開更新後到最優點的平方距離。無偏性換掉隨機內積；凸性給出 ∇f(w)ᵀ(w−w*)≥f(w)−f*。
*[Added clarification] Expand the squared distance after an update. Unbiasedness replaces the random inner product. Convexity bounds the objective gap by the gradient inner product.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p08-n06.text:
計算順序：符號式、代入、理由、結果。
*Follow the symbolic expression, substitution, reason, and result.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n01.text: 再確認：加權平均輸出有期望函數誤差界

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n02.text: Pause and restate the qualified claim.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p09-n04.text:
口訣：先看量測量，再看假設。O(η) 表示長期保證的量級；沒有下界，就不能說永遠到不了最優。
*Read the error measure and assumptions first. O(η) describes the scale of a long-run guarantee. Without a lower bound, impossibility does not follow.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n01.text: 加權平均輸出有期望函數誤差界

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n02.text: A weighted-average output has an expected objective-error bound.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p10-n05.text:
[補充／更正] 把距離項加總後抵消；對加權平均用凸性。D=‖w₁−w*‖。這不是每次軌跡或最後一步的保證。
*[Added clarification] Distance terms telescope after summation. Apply convexity to the weighted average, with D as the initial distance. This does not guarantee every trajectory or the final iterate.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p11-n05.text:
遞減步長使累積步長持續成長，平方步長成長較慢。固定步長留下 ηG²/2 項。圖只顯示來源玩具上界的形狀。

*Diminishing steps make accumulated steps grow faster than accumulated squared steps. Fixed steps leave an ηG²/2 term. The graph only illustrates source toy bounds.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p13-n02.text: Nonconvex analysis usually guarantees stationarity rather than global optimality.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p13-n05.text:
[補充／更正] 只假設下界與光滑，不能推出全局函數誤差。若梯度無偏、雜訊方差≤σ²、0<η≤1/L，平均平方梯度有下式；小梯度仍可能是鞍點。
*[Added clarification] A lower bound and smoothness do not ensure global objective error. With unbiased gradients, variance at most σ², and 0<η≤1/L, the mean squared gradient obeys this bound. Small gradients may occur at saddles.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n01.text: 強凸的速率仍須標出輸出與步長

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n02.text: Strong-convexity rates still depend on outputs and step choices.

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p14-n04.text:
強凸例：適當遞減步長及平均可得期望函數誤差 O(1/t)；非任意最後一步。固定步長得到幾何暫態加 O(η) 上界，收縮因子依步長而變。
*With suitable decreasing steps and averaging, strong convexity gives O(1/t) expected objective error. An arbitrary last iterate is not implied. Fixed steps yield geometric transients plus an O(η) bound.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n01.text: 來源的強凸式需要補上適用限制

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n02.text: The source strong-convexity expressions need explicit qualifications.

*Source equation (35) uses 1/(μτ) and O(1/t), requiring suitable averaging and additional assumptions.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p15-n05.text:
式(36)的 1−μ/L 不是任意固定 η 的通用係數。
*In equation (36), 1−μ/L is not universal for every constant η.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p17-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p17-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p17-n05.text:
醉漢下山、直升機盤旋都提醒步長與雜訊。實際步幅是 ηg，不是固定 η；帶子是誤差上界量級，不是參數距離。全梯度仍可額外算，只是較貴。
*The downhill and hovering analogies suggest noise and step-size effects. Actual displacement is ηg, not η. The band describes an error-bound scale, not parameter distance. Full gradients remain computable but costly.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p18-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p18-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p18-n04.text:
全梯度下降（命題 2）在 t→∞ 時的收斂行為是？
*What happens as t tends to infinity in Proposition 2?*
A. 停滯在 O(η) 鄰域
*A. Stagnation in an O(η) neighborhood*
B. 精確收斂到 f*，誤差趨近 0
*B. Objective error tends to zero*
C. 發散
*C. Divergence*
D. 收斂率為 O(log t)
*D. An O(log t) convergence rate*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n07.text:
B. 在最優點附近 O(η) 鄰域內停滯

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n09.text:
C. 步長自動歸零

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n11.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n11
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n11.text:
D. 比全梯度更快收斂
*D. SGD converges faster than full-gradient descent.*

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n13.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p19-n13

lec03-bp-v2-u09-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u09-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u09-p20-n04.text:
下列哪組步長策略能讓 SGD 的 1/t 項主導、使長期誤差趨近 0？
*Which source schedule is intended to make long-run error vanish?*
A. 固定 ητ=η
*A. Fixed η*
B. ητ=1/τ 或 1/√τ
*B. 1/τ or 1/√τ*
C. ητ=τ
*C. τ*
D. 不更新步長
*D. No step-size change*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n01.text: AdaGrad 為每個座標各記一本帳

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n02.text: AdaGrad keeps a separate history for each coordinate.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n04.text:
梯度 gₜ,j
*Read the coordinate gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n05.text:
累積 sₜ,j
*Accumulate its squared history.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n06.text:
縮放更新 wₜ,j
*Scale the parameter update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p01-n09.text:
gₜ,j 是第 t 步、第 j 座標的樣本梯度。先累積平方，再縮放當前梯度。j 是座標索引，iₜ 是樣本索引，不能互換。s是累積平方，η是全局率，ε是防零項。
*The gradient gₜ,j belongs to coordinate j at step t. Accumulate its squares before scaling the current gradient. Coordinate j and sample index iₜ must remain distinct. s accumulates squares, η is the global rate, and ε prevents zero denominators.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n01.text: 大梯度例子的縮放可逐行算出

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n02.text: The large-gradient example can be checked line by line.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p02-n04.text:
取 η=0.2、ε=0，歷史梯度 3、4、12。累積平方作分母；最後一筆 12 作分子。ε=0 只用於非零分母的示例。
*Use η=0.2, ε=0, and gradients 3, 4, 12. The denominator uses squared history; the numerator uses the current value 12. Zero ε is safe only in this nonzero example.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n01.text: 練習：辨識 AdaGrad 的累積器

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n04.text:

*What defines G(j,j) in AdaGrad?*
A. 梯度的絕對值之和
*A. A sum of absolute gradients*
B. 梯度平方的累積和再開根號
*B. The square root of accumulated squared gradients*
C. 梯度的指數移動平均
*C. An exponential gradient average*
D. Hessian 對角元素
*D. A Hessian diagonal entry*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p03-n05.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p04-n02.text: The reins adjust effective rates without guaranteeing equal updates.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p04-n04.text:
口訣「誰跑得兇誰被勒韁」：較厚的平方帳本壓低有效學習率。實際步幅還要乘當前梯度，不能只看分母。
*The reins analogy says that larger squared histories reduce effective learning rates. Actual displacement also depends on the current gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n01.text: 矩陣形式與座標形式描述同一更新

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n02.text: Matrix and coordinate forms describe the same update.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p05-n05.text:
Gₜ 是 d×d 對角矩陣，不是 Hessian。來源式(39)把樣本與座標混用；此處改爲同一個 gₜ,j。
*Gₜ is a d-by-d diagonal matrix, not the Hessian. Source equation (39) mixes sample and coordinate indices. Here both forms use the same gₜ,j.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n01.text: 符號與初始條件要逐座標設定

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n02.text: Symbols and initialization must be specified per coordinate.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n04.text:
初始 s₀,j=0。通常 ε>0 防零；若 ε=0 且歷史梯度全零，分母是零。AdaGrad 不需要二階導數。
*Initialize s₀,j=0. Positive ε prevents division by zero. With ε=0 and an entirely zero history, the denominator vanishes. AdaGrad requires no second derivatives.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n06.text:
樣本、座標、參數數量
*Sample index, coordinate index, dimension*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n09.text:
在 wₜ₋₁ 計算的座標梯度
*Coordinate gradient evaluated at wₜ₋₁*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n12.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n12
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n12.text:
累積平方、對角縮放矩陣
*Squared-history accumulator and diagonal scaling*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n15.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n15
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p06-n15.text:
全局率、穩定項、有效率
*Global rate, stabilizer, effective rate*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n01.text: 較小梯度歷史讓有效率較大

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n02.text: A smaller gradient history yields a larger effective rate.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p07-n04.text:
安靜座標的歷史是 0.3、0.4、1.2。先算平方和，再求有效率與當前步幅。這個等幅結果來自兩組梯度恰好成比例。
*The quiet coordinate has history 0.3, 0.4, 1.2. Compute squares, effective rate, then displacement. Equal updates occur here because the histories are proportional.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n01.text: 長期衰減須以累積平方無界為條件

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n02.text: Long-run decay requires unbounded accumulated squares.

image.alt: Read accumulated steps before effective rates. The curve is 1/√t for unit gradients, η=1, and ε=0; its zero limit relies on growing squared history.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n05.text:
若每步 g=1、η=1、ε=0，aₜ=1/√t。t=1、100、10000 得 1、0.1、0.01。若某座標的平方和有界，不能宣稱所有有效率必歸零。
*With g=1, η=1, and ε=0, aₜ=1/√t. At 1, 100, and 10000 steps, rates are 1, 0.1, and 0.01. Bounded squared histories need not yield zero rates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p08-n06.text:
讀圖：先看累積步數，再讀有效學習率。
*Read the horizontal axis, then compare the marked quantities.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n01.text: 稀疏友好不等於判斷特徵重要性

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n02.text: Sparse-feature adaptation does not measure feature importance.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n04.text:
罕見非零梯度常有較小累積器，更新可較不受壓制。
*Rare nonzero gradients often have smaller accumulators and less scaling suppression.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p09-n05.text:
勒韁、發言限時比喻只描述歷史縮放；大梯度未必重要，少發言未必有用。
*Reins and speaking-time analogies describe history-based scaling, not feature importance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n01.text: AdaGrad 累積器只增，但不凍結座標

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n02.text: AdaGrad accumulators grow without freezing coordinates.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p10-n04.text:
平方和不減，固定全局率下有效率不增。步幅並非只由歷史決定；可能衰減過快，也可能仍持續更新。實際訓練要看損失與更新量。
*Squared histories never decrease, so effective rates do not increase with a fixed global rate. Updates also depend on current gradients. Monitor loss and displacement for excessive decay.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n01.text: 練習：判斷活躍座標的縮放

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n02.text: Practice: interpret scaling for an active coordinate.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n04.text:
AdaGrad 對「梯度長期偏大」的維度會做什麼？
*What does AdaGrad do to a coordinate with persistently large gradients?*
A. 放大其有效學習率
*A. Increase its effective rate*
B. 壓制（衰減）其有效學習率
*B. Reduce its effective rate*
C. 凍結該維度
*C. Freeze it*
D. 重置其梯度
*D. Reset its gradient*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p11-n05.text:
提示：區分有效率與實際步幅；觀察累積平方改變的是哪個量。
*Hint: distinguish the effective learning rate from displacement. Identify the quantity changed by accumulated squares.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n04.text:
式(39)中 ε 的作用是？
*What is the role of ε in equation (39)?*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n05.text:
A. 控制動量係數
*A. It controls the momentum coefficient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n07.text:
B. 確保分母不為零，提供數值穩定
*B. It prevents division by zero and improves numerical stability.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n09.text:
C. 設定 batch size
*C. It specifies the batch size.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n11.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n11
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n11.text:
D. 決定偏置修正
*D. It determines the bias correction.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n13.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n13
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p12-n13.text:
提示：代入一個從未收到非零梯度的座標，檢查分母。
*Hint: consider a coordinate that has never received a nonzero gradient and inspect its denominator.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n01.text: 實作要分清平方和與動量

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n02.text: Implementation must separate squared history from momentum.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n04.text:
錯：把 G 當二階導數，或把 ε 當動量。
*Incorrect: interpreting G as second derivatives or ε as momentum.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p13-n05.text:
正：G 由一階梯度平方構成；動量平滑方向，AdaGrad 縮放座標步幅。
*Correct: G uses squared first derivatives. Momentum smooths direction; AdaGrad rescales coordinate updates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n01.text: 練習：判斷長期訓練的風險

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n04.text:
AdaGrad 長期訓練的主要隱憂是？
*What is a main risk of long AdaGrad training?*
A. 學習率單調遞增
*A. Monotonically increasing rates*
B. 累積和只增不減，有效學習率趨近 0
*B. Accumulation can drive effective rates toward zero*
C. 無法處理稀疏特徵
*C. Inability to handle sparse features*
D. 需要計算 Hessian
*D. Required Hessian computation*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n05.text:
提示：來源選項的趨零須加「平方和無界」條件；想想哪種歷史會滿足。
*Hint: the zero-rate limit requires unbounded squared history. Consider histories that satisfy this condition.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p14-n06.text:
先列條件，再核對公式。
*State the conditions before applying a formula.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n01.text: 再確認：練習：用新歷史算一次更新

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n02.text: Pause and restate the qualified claim.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p15-n04.text:
口訣「誰跑得兇誰被勒韁」：較厚的平方帳本壓低有效學習率。實際步幅還要乘當前梯度，不能只看分母。
*The reins analogy says that larger squared histories reduce effective learning rates. Actual displacement also depends on the current gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n01.text: 練習：用新歷史算一次更新

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n02.text: Practice: compute an update from a new history.

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n04.text:
η=0.5、ε=0，某座標歷史梯度為 6、8。有效學習率與當下梯度 8 的步幅各是多少？
*With η=0.5, ε=0, and gradient history 6, 8, compute the effective rate and displacement for the current gradient 8.*

lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u10-p16-n05.text:
提示：先算 6²+8²，再開根號，最後乘當前梯度。
*Hint: sum 6² and 8², take the square root, then multiply the effective rate by the current gradient.*

lec03-bp-v2-frame-u10.name: KP10：AdaGrad 用逐座標平方歷史
lec03-bp-v2-frame-u10.text: AdaGrad 用逐座標平方歷史

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n01.text: RMSProp 會忘，Adam 再加方向記憶

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n02.text: RMSProp forgets old squares, and Adam adds direction memory.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n06.text:
Adam：方向與校正
*Adam adds direction and correction.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p01-n09.text:
AdaGrad 保存全部平方歷史。RMSProp 用指數平均衰減舊平方；Adam 再平均梯度方向與修正零初始偏差。三者仍需選全局學習率。
*AdaGrad retains all squared history. RMSProp exponentially discounts old squares. Adam also averages gradient directions and corrects zero-initialization bias. Each still needs a global learning rate.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n01.text: 第一步的零初始偏差可以逐行驗算

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n02.text: The first-step initialization bias can be checked directly.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p02-n04.text:
取 β₁=β₂=0.9、m₀=v₀=0、g₁=4。一維示範先更新原始矩，再除以已累積的權重 0.1。β是遺忘係數；m與v記錄梯度及平方平均。
*Use β₁=β₂=0.9, m₀=v₀=0, and g₁=4. Update the moments first, then divide by the accumulated weight 0.1. β controls decay; m and v average gradients and their squares.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n01.text: 練習：說明偏置修正的目的

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n02.text: Practice: explain the purpose of bias correction.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n04.text:
Adam 偏置修正（式(44)–(45)）的目的是？
*What is the purpose of Adam bias correction?*
A. 加速收斂到 sharp minima
*A. Accelerate convergence to sharp minima*
B. 補償早期迭代中 m、v 初始為 0 造成的系統性偏差
*B. Compensate for zero-initialization bias in m and v*
C. 增大 batch size
*C. Increase batch size*
D. 替代 L2 正則化
*D. Replace L2 regularization*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p03-n05.text:
提示：先展開兩步指數平均的權重和，再比較是否加總爲一。
*Hint: expand the first two exponential averages and inspect whether their weights sum to one.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n01.text: 偏置修正用已完成的更新次數

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n02.text: Bias correction uses the number of completed updates.

image.alt: Read completed updates t, then the factor 1/(1−0.9ᵗ). It starts at 10, becomes about 5.263, and approaches one. It is a correction factor, not loss or a learning rate.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n05.text:
第 t 次更新用 1−βᵗ。β=0.9 時，t=1 因子 10；t=2 因子約 5.263。來源 k+1 的矩搭 k 次方有錯位，已更正。
*The t-th update uses 1−βᵗ. With β=0.9, factors are 10 at t=1 and about 5.263 at t=2. The source mismatched moment index k+1 with exponent k; this is corrected.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p04-n06.text:
讀圖：先看已完成次數t，再看修正因子1/(1−0.9ᵗ)。
*Read the horizontal axis, then compare the marked quantities.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p05-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p05-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p05-n02.text: The second raw moment is not the variance.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p05-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p05-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p05-n04.text:
m 估計梯度一階矩；v 估計逐座標梯度平方的二階原始矩。方差需再扣掉均值平方；v 本身不能叫方差。
*m estimates first gradient moments. v estimates coordinatewise second raw moments. Variance additionally subtracts the squared mean; v itself is not variance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n01.text: RMSProp 的平方與除法都是逐座標

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n02.text: RMSProp squares and divides coordinate by coordinate.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p06-n05.text:
gₜ 是在 wₜ₋₁ 的梯度，v₀=0，0≤β<1。來源用 ‖g‖² 是全局純量，不能代表標準逐座標 RMSProp。這裏ε放根號內，沿用來源。
*gₜ is evaluated at wₜ₋₁, with v₀=0 and 0≤β<1. The source scalar squared norm does not describe standard coordinatewise RMSProp. Here ε remains inside the root as in the source.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n01.text: 兩個矩向量保留每個座標的尺度

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n02.text: Two moment vectors preserve the scale of each coordinate.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n04.text:
所有 m、v 都是 d 維向量。逐座標平方 g⊙g 與純量 ‖g‖² 維度不同；第二個會混合所有座標的尺度。
*Both m and v are d-dimensional vectors. The elementwise square g⊙g differs dimensionally from scalar ‖g‖². The scalar mixes scales across coordinates.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n06.text:
梯度、一階、二階原始矩向量
*Gradient and first/second raw moment vectors*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n09.text:
各矩的遺忘係數，介於0與1
*Decay coefficients in [0,1)*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n12.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n12
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n12.text:
已更新次數、全局率、穩定項
*Completed updates, global rate, stabilizer*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n15.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n15
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p07-n15.text:
初始偏置修正矩向量
*Initialization-bias-corrected moments*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n01.text: Adam 同時平滑方向與平方尺度

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n02.text: Adam smooths both directions and squared scales.

image.alt: Read zero-gradient steps after the first spike. Compare the accumulator 100 with the exponential average 10×0.9ʳ. These squared scales do not imply parameter displacement at every step.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n05.text:
平方、平方根與除法都逐座標運算。這是偏置修正前的原始矩；來源稱「梯度方差」已改成二階原始矩。
*Squaring, roots, and division operate elementwise. These are raw moments before correction. The source term gradient variance is replaced with second raw moment.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p08-n06.text:
讀圖：先看初次大梯度之後的零梯度次數r，再比較累加器100與指數平均10×0.9ʳ。
*Read the horizontal axis, then compare the marked quantities.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p09-n01

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p09-n05.text:
平方、平方根與除法都逐座標運算。這是偏置修正前的原始矩；來源稱「梯度方差」已改成二階原始矩。
*Squaring, roots, and division operate elementwise. These are raw moments before correction. The source term gradient variance is replaced with second raw moment.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p10-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p10-n01

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p10-n04.text:
m 估計梯度一階矩；v 估計逐座標梯度平方的二階原始矩。方差需再扣掉均值平方；v 本身不能叫方差。
*m estimates first gradient moments. v estimates coordinatewise second raw moments. Variance additionally subtracts the squared mean; v itself is not variance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n01.text: 修正權重後再更新參數

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n02.text: Correct the accumulated weight before updating parameters.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p11-n05.text:
採 Adam 原論文 ε 放根號外；來源放根號內是不同穩定方式，不可共用同一ε數值。β₁、β₂須小於1，t從1開始。
*Use ε outside the root, as in the Adam paper. The source places it inside, a different stabilizing convention. The same ε values are not interchangeable. Decays are below one and t starts at one.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n01.text: 常數梯度揭示偏置來自權重不足

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n02.text: Constant gradients reveal missing weight at initialization.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p12-n04.text:
若每步都是同一 g，從零開始展開等比和。β爲一階或二階矩各自的係數；兩者可不同。修正消除零初始權重缺額，不保證非平穩梯度估計無偏。
*With constant g, expand the geometric sum from zero. Each moment may use a different β. Correction removes missing initial weight; changing gradient distributions may still create bias.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n02.text: The correction factor gradually approaches one.

image.alt: Read completed updates t, then the factor 1/(1−0.9ᵗ). It starts at 10, becomes about 5.263, and approaches one. It is a correction factor, not loss or a learning rate.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n05.text:
〔程式計算〕β=0.9，依 cₜ=1/(1−0.9ᵗ) 計算。t 越大，零初始的欠缺權重越小；圖不表示 loss 或收斂率。
*Computed with β=0.9 and cₜ=1/(1−0.9ᵗ). Initialization has less influence as t grows. The graph is not a loss or convergence curve.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p13-n06.text:
讀圖：先看已完成次數t，再看修正因子1/(1−0.9ᵗ)。
*Read the horizontal axis, then compare the marked quantities.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n01.text: 修正因子逐漸接近一（數值表）

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n02.text: Read the exact values behind the comparison.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p14-n04.text:
〔程式計算〕β=0.9，依 cₜ=1/(1−0.9ᵗ) 計算。t 越大，零初始的欠缺權重越小；圖不表示 loss 或收斂率。
*Computed with β=0.9 and cₜ=1/(1−0.9ᵗ). Initialization has less influence as t grows. The graph is not a loss or convergence curve.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n01.text: 核對條件：較晚的修正值仍可追溯

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n02.text: Check the conditions before reading the next formula.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p15-n04.text:
m 估計梯度一階矩；v 估計逐座標梯度平方的二階原始矩。方差需再扣掉均值平方；v 本身不能叫方差。
*m estimates first gradient moments. v estimates coordinatewise second raw moments. Variance additionally subtracts the squared mean; v itself is not variance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p16-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p16-n01.text: 較晚的修正值仍可追溯

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p16-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p16-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p16-n04.text:
〔程式計算〕β=0.9，t=20 得 βᵗ≈0.122、1−βᵗ≈0.878、c≈1.14。t→∞，βᵗ→0、分母→1、因子→1。
*For β=0.9 at t=20, βᵗ≈0.122, 1−βᵗ≈0.878, and c≈1.14. As t tends to infinity, these quantities tend to zero, one, and one.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n01.text: 一維例子的方向比值不等於實際步長

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n02.text: The scalar direction ratio is not the actual step size.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p17-n04.text:
用前例 g=4、β₁=β₂=0.9，暫忽略ε。未修正比值約0.316，修正後是1；真正參數步幅還要乘η。不同β不保證同樣倍數。
*Using g=4 and equal decays 0.9, temporarily ignore ε. The raw ratio is about 0.316; the corrected ratio is one. Actual displacement also multiplies η. Other decay choices change this comparison.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n01.text: 遺忘可減少舊大梯度的影響

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n02.text: Forgetting reduces the influence of an old large gradient.

image.alt: Read zero-gradient steps after the first spike. Compare the accumulator 100 with the exponential average 10×0.9ʳ. These squared scales do not imply parameter displacement at every step.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n05.text:
先 g=10 後全0：AdaGrad s=100；RMSProp 首次 v=0.1×100=10。再過10或20個零梯度，v=10×0.9ʳ 約3.49或1.22。這不意味着當下非零更新。
*After g=10 followed by zeros, AdaGrad keeps s=100. RMSProp first gives v=10, then about 3.49 or 1.22 after 10 or 20 zero gradients. Forgetting does not imply nonzero updates at those times.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p18-n06.text:
讀圖：先看初次大梯度之後的零梯度次數r，再比較累加器100與指數平均10×0.9ʳ。
*Read the horizontal axis, then compare the marked quantities.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n01.text: 油表與體重計只比喻初始欠讀

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n02.text: The gauge and scale analogies describe initialization underreading.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n04.text:
健忘油表記住近期平方；剛換電池體重計比喻從0啟動。
*A forgetful gauge emphasizes recent squares. A newly powered scale suggests zero initialization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p19-n05.text:
真實梯度會改變，修正不會把所有歷史變成當前梯度；η仍決定保守程度。
*Real gradients change, so correction does not replace history with the current gradient. η still controls the update scale.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n01.text: 自適應不能替代驗證或學習率選擇

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n02.text: Adaptation does not replace validation or learning-rate selection.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p20-n04.text:
Adam 是常用選項之一，並非所有任務默認贏家。RMSProp不無限累加；偏置修正不取代正則化、不保證全局最優，也不消除步長選擇。
*Adam is a widely used option, not a universal winner. RMSProp does not accumulate forever. Bias correction neither replaces regularization nor guarantees global optimality or removes step-size selection.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n01.text: 練習：辨識 RMSProp 的改進

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n04.text:
RMSProp 相對 AdaGrad 的關鍵改進是？
*What is the key RMSProp change relative to AdaGrad?*
A. 引入 Hessian 資訊
*A. Hessian information*
B. 用指數移動平均取代梯度平方的累積和
*B. An exponential average instead of accumulated gradient squares*
C. 取消學習率
*C. Elimination of learning rates*
D. 改用全梯度
*D. Full-gradient updates*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p21-n05.text:
提示：展開一筆舊平方在下一步的權重，比較是否會衰減。
*Hint: track the weight of an old squared gradient through the next update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n01.text: 練習：檢查原題的矩名稱

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n02.text: Practice: check moment terminology in the source question.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n04.text:
Adam 同時維護哪兩種矩估計？
*Which two moment estimates does Adam maintain?*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n05.text:
A. 梯度的均值與方差（一階矩與二階矩）
*A. Adam estimates the gradient mean and variance (first and second moments).*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n07.text:
B. 損失的均值與方差
*B. Adam estimates the mean and variance of the losses.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n09.text:
C. 權重的均值與方差
*C. Adam estimates the mean and variance of the weights.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n11.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n11
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n11.text:
D. 激活值的均值與方差
*D. Adam estimates the mean and variance of activation values.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n13.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n13
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p22-n13.text:
提示：選項按原文保留，但「方差」一詞須修訂。以公式判斷統計對象與是否扣掉均值平方。
*Hint: source choices are preserved, but variance needs editorial correction. Inspect the estimated object and whether squared means are subtracted.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n01.text: 練習：審慎理解 Adam 的實務地位

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n02.text: Practice: interpret the practical role of Adam carefully.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n04.text:
下列何者正確描述 Adam 在實務中的地位？
*Which describes the practical role of Adam?*
A. 僅用於理論研究
*A. Only theoretical research*
B. 現代深度學習中最廣泛使用的優化器之一
*B. One of the widely used deep-learning optimizers*
C. 已被 SGD 完全取代
*C. Completely replaced by SGD*
D. 只能用在凸優化
*D. Applicable only to convex optimization*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n05.text:
提示：區分廣泛採用與在任何任務上優於其他方法；還需公平的驗證集比較。
*Hint: distinguish widespread use from universal superiority. Compare methods using a fair validation protocol.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p23-n06.text:
先列條件，再核對公式。
*State the conditions before applying a formula.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n01.text: 實作順序先計梯度，再更新矩與參數

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n02.text: Implementation updates gradients, moments, and parameters in order.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n04.text:
t 從1開始；平方使用逐元素乘法。ε位置須與實作文件一致。不要在梯度函式求值前先改動權重。
*Start t at one and square elementwise. Match the stabilizer convention in the implementation. Evaluate the gradient before changing the parameters.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p24-n05.text:
t += 1
g = gradient(w)
m = b1*m + (1-b1)*g
v = b2*v + (1-b2)*(g*g)
mhat = m/(1-pow(b1,t))
vhat = v/(1-pow(b2,t))
w = w - eta*mhat/(sqrt(vhat)+eps)

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n01.text: 再確認：練習：計算第二步的修正

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n02.text: Pause and restate the qualified claim.

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p25-n04.text:
m 估計梯度一階矩；v 估計逐座標梯度平方的二階原始矩。方差需再扣掉均值平方；v 本身不能叫方差。
*m estimates first gradient moments. v estimates coordinatewise second raw moments. Variance additionally subtracts the squared mean; v itself is not variance.*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n01.text: 練習：計算第二步的修正

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n04.text:
β=0.9、t=2，修正因子是多少？若未修正 m=0.58，修正後 m̂ 是多少？
*With β=0.9 and t=2, find the correction factor. If raw m=0.58, what is corrected m̂?*

lec03-bp-v2-u11-p26-n05.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p03-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p03-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p03-n04.text:
根據 Fig.6，flat minimum 與 sharp minimum 的主要差異是？
*What chiefly distinguishes flat and sharp minima in Figure 6?*
A. flat 的損失值較高
*A. Flat minima have higher loss*
B. flat 解的鄰域內損失幾乎不變，sharp 則急劇上升
*B. Flat neighborhoods change little while sharp ones rise quickly*
C. sharp 一定泛化更好
*C. Sharp minima always generalize better*
D. 兩者數學上完全相同
*D. They are mathematically identical*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n01.text: 平坦是有條件的線索，不是保證

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n02.text: Flatness is a conditional clue rather than a guarantee.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p04-n04.text:
參數座標與尺度會改變測得的銳度。參數擾動與資料分佈偏移不是同一件事。泛化須用未見資料評估，不能由這兩條曲線推出。
*Parameter coordinates and scales can change measured sharpness. Parameter perturbations differ from data distribution shifts. Generalization requires unseen-data evaluation and does not follow from these curves.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p05-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p05-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p05-n01.text: 原圖六保留其尖谷與寬谷的概念

*Inspect curvature near the original minima and compare neighboring rises. The original figure provides no toy-function data. The analytic plot matches the numeric example, not an exact reconstruction of Figure 6.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p05-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p05-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p05-n06.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p06-n02.text: Symbols distinguish parameter neighborhoods from data generalization.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p06-n04.text:
這裏一維w只爲算例。真實網絡w是向量；參數鄰域受範數與尺度定義影響。測試誤差仍需另行估計。
*Scalar w serves this example only. Network parameters form a vector, and neighborhood geometry depends on norms and scales. Test error must be estimated separately.*

*Neighborhood radius and parameter perturbation*

*Training loss and two toy functions*

鄰域低變化、鄰域快速上升
*Low versus high neighborhood sensitivity*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n01.text: SAM 的動機是同時看點與整個鄰域

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n02.text: SAM is motivated by the loss across a neighborhood.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n05.text:
鄰域高損失
*Consider nearby high loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n06.text:
降低局部最壞值
*Reduce local worst-case loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p07-n09.text:
標準訓練降低當前點損失。SAM 先尋鄰域高損失，再降低這個局部最壞情況。這是目標調整，不是取代反向傳播；演算法留給後續單元。
*Standard training lowers loss at the current parameters. SAM considers high-loss neighbors before reducing local worst-case loss. It changes the objective, not backpropagation. Algorithmic details follow later.*

*[Added clarification] For f(w)=b+aw², the minimum is at zero and a perturbation δ raises loss by aδ². Coefficients 50 and 0.5 give a 100-fold difference in increases, not necessarily total losses.*

*[Added clarification] For f(w)=b+aw², the minimum is at zero and a perturbation δ raises loss by aδ². Coefficients 50 and 0.5 give a 100-fold difference in increases, not necessarily total losses.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p10-n02.text: Retain every source displacement and substitute explicitly.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p10-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p10-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p10-n04.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n01.text: 最低值排序與鄰域最大值排序可不同

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n02.text: Minimum ordering can differ from neighborhood-maximum ordering.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n04.text:
兩個函數最低值差0.07；ρ=0.2內最大值2.01與0.10，相差20.1倍。

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p11-n05.text:
這隻比較不同玩具目標，不能說普通訓練一定選針谷。

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n01.text: 針尖與停車只比喻局部敏感度

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n02.text: The needle and parking analogies describe local sensitivity.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p12-n04.text:
保留「針尖 vs 寬碗」與停車遇風的比喻，但極小值是谷底，不是山峯。風只對應參數偏移，不能直接等同測試資料改變。
*Keep the needle-versus-bowl and parking-in-wind analogies. A minimum is a valley, not a peak. Wind stands for parameter displacement, not automatically a change in test data.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n01.text: 方法類型不足以保證解的平坦度

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n02.text: The optimizer category alone does not guarantee flatness.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n04.text:
來源的一階偏平、二階偏尖屬情境性直覺，非通用定理。
*The source preference for flatter first-order and sharper second-order solutions is contextual, not universal.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p13-n05.text:
重參數化可改形狀而不改模型預測；平坦度不單獨決定泛化。
*Reparameterization can change shape without changing predictions. Flatness alone does not determine generalization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n01.text: 練習：判斷平坦與泛化的證據強度

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n02.text: Practice: assess evidence linking flatness and generalization.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n04.text:
關於「平坦極小值泛化更好」這個主張，正確敘述是？

A. 已被嚴格證明，無任何爭議
*A. Proved without controversy*
B. 有經驗支持，但文獻中仍有辯論
*B. Empirically supported but still debated*
C. 已被完全否定
*C. Completely refuted*
D. 只適用於線性模型
*D. Applicable only to linear models*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p14-n05.text:

*Hint: distinguish empirical associations from unconditional theorems and examine whether parameter scales are fixed.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n01.text: 練習：辨識原文的方法傾向

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n02.text: Practice: recognize a conditional source intuition.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n04.text:
一階方法（如 SGD）相對二階方法，在極小值「形狀」上的傾向是？
*What shape tendency does the source attribute to first-order methods relative to second-order methods?*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n05.text:
A. 傾向找到更尖銳的極小值
*A. First-order methods tend to find sharper local minima.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n07.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n07
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n07.text:
B. 傾向找到更平坦的極小值
*B. First-order methods tend to find flatter local minima.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n09.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n09
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n09.text:
C. 兩者無差異
*C. The two method types show no difference.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n11.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n11
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p15-n11.text:
D. 一階方法找不到極小值
*D. First-order methods cannot find local minima.*

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p17-n02.text: Practice: explain the motivation for SAM.

lec03-bp-v2-u12-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u12-p17-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u12-p17-n04.text:
SAM 算法的核心動機是？
*What motivates SAM?*
A. 加速每次迭代的計算
*A. Faster individual iterations*
B. 主動尋找平坦解，懲罰鄰域內的高損失
*B. Penalizing high neighborhood loss to seek flatter solutions*
C. 取代反向傳播
*C. Replacing backpropagation*
D. 消除所有局部極小值
*D. Eliminating all local minima*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p04-n05.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p04-n07.text:

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p04-n08.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p04-n08
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p04-n08.text:

*D. A new random initialization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p05-n02.text: Regularization is a separate term in the SAM objective

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p05-n05.text:
$\lambda\geq0$控制L2懲罰，與鄰域內的最大化不同。
*$\lambda\geq0$ controls the L2 penalty, separately from neighborhood maximization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p05-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p05-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p05-n06.text:
式(47)含正則化；式(49)是省略這項的版本。
*Equation (47) includes regularization; equation (49) omits that term.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n01.text: 銳度量測鄰域損失最大增幅

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n02.text: Sharpness measures the maximum neighborhood loss increase

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n04.text:
$$
\mathcal L_{\rm SAM}(\mathbf w)=\mathcal L(\mathbf w)+\max_{\|\mathbf{\epsilon}\|_p\leq\rho}[\mathcal L(\mathbf w+\mathbf{\epsilon})-\mathcal L(\mathbf w)]
$$

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n05.text:
先加再減同一個目前損失，即可分成兩項。
*Add and subtract the same current loss to obtain two terms.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p06-n06.text:
經驗損失衡量目前點；銳度衡量附近最高增幅。
*Empirical loss evaluates the current point; sharpness measures the largest nearby increase.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n01.text: 線性近似把內層變成向量問題

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n05.text:
梯度$g=\nabla\mathcal L(\mathbf w)$提供局部一階變化。
*The gradient $g=\nabla\mathcal L(\mathbf w)$ gives the local first-order change.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p07-n06.text:
小半徑下近似較合理；不是精確非線性最大化。
*A small radius makes the approximation more plausible; it is not exact nonlinear maximization.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n01.text: 對偶範數決定一般球的解

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n02.text: The dual norm determines the solution on a general norm ball

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n05.text:
對$1<p<\infty$，$1/p+1/q=1$；冪次與符號逐座標作用。
*For $1<p<\infty$, $1/p+1/q=1$; powers and signs act coordinate by coordinate.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p08-n06.text:
端點$p=1$或$\infty$需另處理，不直接代入端點冪次。
*The cases $p=1$ and $p=\infty$ need separate treatment rather than direct substitution.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n01.text: 歐氏球上的擾動沿梯度方向

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n02.text: The Euclidean-ball perturbation follows the gradient

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n05.text:
Cauchy–Schwarz給$\epsilon^\top g\leq\rho\|g\|_2$；同方向可取等號。
*Cauchy–Schwarz gives $\epsilon^\top g\leq\rho\|g\|_2$; aligned vectors attain equality.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p09-n06.text:
這證明的是線性化目標；來源的星號不應暗示原目標精確解。
*This solves the linearized objective; the source asterisk must not imply an exact solution of the original objective.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p11-n02.text: The perturbed point adds the perturbation to the current parameters

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p11-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p11-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p11-n05.text:
來源假設目前參數為$(1.00,2.00)$。
*The source assumes the current parameters are $(1.00,2.00)$.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p11-n06.text:
此點提供第二次梯度，不是最後更新結果。
*This point supplies the second gradient; it is not the final updated parameter.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p12-n01.text: 兩點差不一定等於精確銳度

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p12-n02.text: A two-point difference need not equal exact sharpness

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p12-n04.text:
來源假設兩點損失為0.50與0.73，差為$0.73-0.50=0.23$。
*The assumed losses are 0.50 and 0.73, giving $0.73-0.50=0.23$.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p12-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p12-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p12-n05.text:
未證明擾動點是最大點，就只能稱取樣或近似損失增幅。
*Unless the perturbed point is proved maximal, this is only a sampled or approximate loss increase.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n01.text: SAM常忽略擾動對參數的導數

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n02.text: SAM commonly ignores the perturbation derivative

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n04

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n05.text:
若追蹤擾動對權重的依賴，鏈式法則還有Jacobian項。
*Tracking the weight dependence of the perturbation adds a Jacobian term.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n06.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n06
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p13-n06.text:

*Implementation treats the perturbation as constant to reduce second-order work; source equation (53) is approximate.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n01.text: 第二次梯度更新仍從原點出發

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n02.text: The second gradient still updates from the original point

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n10.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n10
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n10.text:
先暫時擾動；求第二次梯度後還原，再做優化器更新。
*Perturb temporarily; after the second gradient, restore the original parameters before the optimizer update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n11.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n11
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p14-n11.text:
不能把暫時上坡直接當成最終更新。
*Do not treat the temporary ascent as part of the final parameter update.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n01
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n01.text: 零梯度時正規化公式不可用

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n02.text: The normalized formula is undefined at a zero gradient

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n04
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n04.text:
$\|g\|_2=0$時，來源公式會除以零；可令近似擾動為零。
*When $\|g\|_2=0$, the source formula divides by zero; the approximate perturbation may be set to zero.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n05.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n05
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p15-n05.text:
零一階資訊不表示附近完全平坦，曲率仍可能造成損失變化。
*Zero first-order information does not imply a flat neighborhood; curvature may still change the loss.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p16-n01.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p16-n01

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n02.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n02
lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n02.text: Use the definitions to distinguish the alternatives

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n04.name: lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n04

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n10.text:
C. 對小批次取平均

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p17-n12.text:
D. 固定擾動為零
*D. Fix the perturbation at zero.*

*Which expression is the sharpness term in equation (50)?*

*A. The current loss $\mathcal L(\mathbf w)$.*

B. 鄰域內最大損失增幅
*B. The maximum loss increase in the neighborhood.*

C. 權重平方範數
*C. The squared weight norm.*

D. 梯度範數
*D. The gradient norm.*

*How is source equation (52) written for a nonzero gradient?*

*A. Multiply the gradient by $\rho$.*

lec03-bp-v2-u13-p19-n08.text:
B. $\rho g/\|g\|_2$
*B. Scale the unit gradient by $\rho$.*

*C. Use the zero vector.*
